title: F&B Concessions Coordinator
description:
Department

Tournament and Venue Operations

Location

Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

Working alongside the FIFA/FIFA27 Partnership Rights Delivery (PRD) team and reporting to the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager in Zurich and the FIFA27 Senior F&B Concessions Manager, the F&B Concessions Coordinator supports the operational planning and delivery of the Public Food and Beverage (F&B) Concessions Programme for stadium spectators and fulfillment of FIFA’s Commercial Partners’ contractual rights and obligations across all stadiums at the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. The objective is to implement and deliver successfully the FIFA Commercial Partners’ exclusive food & beverage rights. This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful tournament through the delivery of FIFA’s commercial operations in the host country. The role operates under the supervision of the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager and the FIFA27 Senior F&B Concessions Manager and does not carry direct commercial ownership or decision‑making authority over F&B concessionaire or Commercial Partner agreements.

Key Responsibilities

  • The main responsibilities of the F&B Concessions Coordinator for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ encompass supporting the planning, coordination, and operational delivery of the F&B Concessions Programme, including but not limited to:
  • Support the implementation of the Public F&B Concessions Programme across all eight stadiums, including timeline tracking, milestone follow‑up, and coordination of deliverables.
  • Assist in integrating Commercial Partner products and services within the F&B Concessions Programme.
  • Support the planning and operational implementation of the commercial rights granted to FIFA’s Commercial Partners within the F&B Concessions Programme.
  • Coordinate with appointed F&B Concessionaire(s), service providers, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth information flow and execution of services within the F&B Concessions project.
  • Provide administrative and organisational support throughout the F&B concessionaire tender (RFP) and other related F&B related tender processes, including documentation management, evaluation support, reporting and assistance in market research activities.
  • Support the review, mapping, preparation, and optimisation of onsite F&B infrastructure and facilities across all official stadiums, ensuring proper documentation and tracking of action points.
  • Track the development and implementation of F&B concepts and operations, menus, pricing, and onsite infrastructure across all stadiums, ensuring deadlines and requirements are met.
  • Coordinate logistics and administrative preparation for stadium inspections and Commercial Partner operational F&B site visits, preparing documentation and follow‑up actions.
  • Support the creation and coordination of F&B-related signage and branding elements (e.g. menu boards).
  • Assist in defining and optimising the service and display of F&B Commercial Partners’ products, supporting alignment between internal and external stakeholders.
  • Prepare reports, presentations, dashboards, and tracking tools using Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, etc.).
  • Assist in developing and maintaining training materials, briefing documents, presentations and operational guidelines.
  • Assist with monitoring daily operations pre‑tournament and during tournament time, ensuring proper documentation and reporting.

Your Profile

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Catering, Hospitality Management, Event Management, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent level of education).

Experience

  • 2 - 4 years of professional experience in food & beverage, catering, hospitality, event management, or a related area.
  • Experience supporting F&B concessions or catering operations, ideally within large‑scale international events, preferably in the sports industry.
  • Exposure to project coordination and administrative support within complex, multi‑stakeholder environments.
  • Experience assisting in infrastructure or operational planning is considered an asset.

Skills & Competencies

  • Good understanding of the food & beverage concessions industry; experience in stadium or event environments is an advantage.
  • Basic knowledge of utilities and infrastructure requirements relevant to F&B operations (e.g. electricity, water supply).
  • Understanding of food safety and hygiene standards applicable to F&B operations.
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
  • Structured working style with high attention to detail and strong follow‑up capabilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and under tight timelines.
  • Proactive and solution‑oriented mindset with a service‑focused approach to commercial rights delivery.

Certification & Requirements

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams; knowledge of Visio and MS Project is an advantage).
  • Experience using planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • Willingness to travel and work extended hours during peak project phases and tournament time.

Candidate Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Bilingual – Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro for the duration of the employment (pre‑tournament and operational tournament time).

Com experiência em gestão de negócios, desde 1955, a WLM atua no segmento automotivo e no agronegócio.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania , como caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, na prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais 20 pontos do país, atendendo a 06 estados diferentes, sendo Equipo - RJ, Itaipu - MG, Itaipu Norte - PA, Quinta Roda - SP e Supermac - AM e RR.

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos e produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com grande preocupação pela conservação do meio ambiente, as atividades produtivas são executadas visando as melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas e cuidados com as águas e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética.

Com essa aquisição, a WLM amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

A localização estratégica das unidades permite uma atuação com abrangente cobertura geográfica, garantindo presteza, qualidade e agilidade no atendimento.

A sua holding está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e possui uma filial corporativa em Minas Gerais, na Cidade de Contagem.

title: Engineer, Rotational / Aspire Program
description:
Job Description

The Rotational Engineer is an entry-level engineering position for newly graduated engineers. Rotating through each of the core business sectors of ABS, the rotational engineer will spend up to four months each working in engineering, survey, and technology. Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the incumbent will develop a thorough understanding of policies, methods, and procedures. Following the completion of each rotation, the engineer will be placed in a permanent role as either Engineer I or Surveyor I.

What You Will Do (under the supervision of an experienced Engineer during the engineering rotation):

  • Performs detailed engineering review of plans as assigned for compliance with applicable Rules, Regulations, and contract commitments.
  • Performs work that involves conventional engineering practices but may include moderately complex problems such as the resolution of conflicting design requirements, material standards, or coordination of activities among other disciplines.
  • With the assistance and guidance of an experienced Surveyor during the survey rotation: Visits vessels, marine structures, and manufacturers for routine survey activities.
  • Performs work that involves conventional surveying practices but may include moderately complex problem resolution and coordination of activities among other disciplines.
  • Conduct research in support of ship and offshore-related classification and rule development.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • BS degree in a related engineering field, including civil, structural, ocean, marine, mechanical, electrical, or naval architecture.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Demonstrated computer literacy in engineering software.
  • The ability to identify, analyze and propose solutions to problems.
  • Good command of the English language.
  • Ability to communicate orally and in writing.
  • Ability to work well with others.
  • Obtain knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management System.

Reporting Relationships

The incumbent reports to the Director, Talent Management. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting‑edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever‑present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Equal Opportunity

ABS and Affiliated Companies (ABS) will not pay a fee to any third‑party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement (MSA) authorized and signed by Human Resources. Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

Descrição da vaga

Na ISH, nosso objetivo é criar um mundo digital seguro e acolhedor . Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Monitorar eventos de segurança utilizando soluções de SIEM, com foco em Splunk.
  • Analisar alertas, identificar falsos positivos e conduzir investigações iniciais.
  • Apoiar e executar atividades de resposta a incidentes de segurança.
  • Participar de salas de crise, contribuindo com análises técnicas e suporte à tomada de decisão.

  • Garantir a aderência aos processos, políticas e padrões globais.
  • Apoiar a implementação (rollout) de ferramentas e controles de segurança corporativos.
  • Apoiar a operação e análise das seguintes soluções de segurança:
    • Firewall (FW)
    • Web Application Firewall (WAF)
    • Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR)
    • Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com os times de infraestrutura, redes e cloud.
  • Apoiar a gestão do ciclo de vida de vulnerabilidades, incluindo:
    • Identificação
    • Análise de risco
    • Acompanhamento dos planos de correção
  • Colaborar com o time de projetos para garantir a adoção de práticas de Security by Design desde as fases iniciais.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência prévia em Segurança da Informação, preferencialmente em Blue Team ou operações de segurança.
  • Conhecimento sólido em ferramentas de SIEM, com preferência por Splunk.
  • Inglês avançado (leitura, escrita e conversação), com capacidade de participar de reuniões técnicas.
  • Vivência em resposta a incidentes de segurança.
  • Conhecimento prático em:
    • Firewall e WAF
    • Soluções de proteção de endpoint (EDR)
    • DLP
    • Redes (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS)
  • Boa comunicação, perfil colaborativo e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.

Requisitos desejáveis (não eliminatórios)

  • Experiência em ambientes multinacionais.
  • Conhecimento em frameworks e boas práticas de segurança, como NIST CSF e ISO 27001.
  • Experiência com Cloud Security (AWS, Azure ou GCP).

  • Certificações relevantes, como CompTIA Security+, Splunk Fundamentals/Power User e ISO 27001 Foundation.

description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform - including its own owned and operated global mobile core network, fully fledged in-house developed eSIM technology, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses - 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide.

We serve many of the world's leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, global fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally , enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues in 2025 exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million , we generate strong cash flows to fund our growth allowing us to continuously invest in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass-consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own aspirations to offer telecommunications services to their clients.

Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs, Hakan Koçand Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications . We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.

About the Team

As a Network Engineering member, in the Voice and Services functional area, you will be responsible to propose, analyze and define the requirements for new and existing services and systems, related with the voice systems under the responsibility of the functional area. Prepare, design, test and provide new solutions or product changes of the already existing portfolio. Define and support the technology evolution roadmap for the systems under the functional area. Participate and support the other functional areas in cross functional projects.

About the Role

  • Collaboration with other Networks teams in defining and managing the projects for delivery of new solutions
  • Project delivery. Network design. Integration and migration strategy definition. Collaboration with other relevant departments. Responsible for end-to-end delivery
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Creation of technical documentation (HLD's, LLD's, WO's, etc.) and maintain it over the lifecycle of the solutions
  • Perform implementations in live environment. Understanding of End to End system testing requirements
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators
  • Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
  • Service & Resource configuration definition and implementation on requested systems
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and addresses design issues for future products or technologies
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers
  • Elaborate, and manage the process, for change requests to current partners in order to meet the network necessities
  • Control the network elements roadmap, being responsible for the necessary software/hardware upgrade during the components lifecycle
  • Generate and implement process improvements, including and especially cross-team processes
  • Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and/or alternatives

Requirements

About You

Must-haves

  • Proven experience on implementation of live solutions on mobile telecom (GSM, UMTS, LTE, IMS), networks design, capacity management, engineering and architecture
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, GSMA, ITU standards and specifications
  • Experience in the design, test and operation of NGN based networks, including MSS/MGW, HLR/HSS, SBC
  • Experience in defining, establishing and maintaining voice interconnects, SIP/RTP based
  • Understanding about IMS architecture. Knowledge about VoIP, VoLTE, VoWiFi, and QoS
  • Experience with SMS service configuration and routing
  • IMS Architecture with understanding of IMS nodes including P/S/I-CSCF, Application Servers
  • IMS Protocol Interfaces - GM Interface, ISC interface, Sh Interface, Cx, SOAP/XML, etc
  • Experience in mobile services charging (offline, online). Knowledge and experience of OCS and, Ro, Ro+, Ga and Bp interfaces
  • Knowledge and experience with Diameter/SCTP networks and protocol
  • Knowledge and experience with Signaling Gateways and protocols including SS7, SIGTRAN, MAP and CAMEL
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot networks errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice-to-haves

  • +3 years working on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks
  • Previous experience with Nokia, Oracle and Ribbon IMS products

Benefits

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave — 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)!

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

  • Empoderamos as pessoas: Somos proativos para solucionar problemas e buscar oportunidades, assumimos responsabilidade pelas atividades exercidas, sem transferi-la para outros.

Se você quer fazer a diferença, achou o lugar certo! Venha fazer história com a gente! #SomosVitus #PorUmaVidaSemDor.

  • Realizar assistência de enfermagem integral aos pacientes, incluindo preparo e administração de medicamentos por via subcutânea, intramuscular e endovenosa, conforme protocolos institucionais e boas práticas de segurança do paciente.

Atuar como elo entre a estratégia definida pela Superintendência e a execução pelas equipes técnicas, assegurando conformidade regulatória, resiliência operacional e alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.

A nossa empresa é feita por gente. Nós já fazemos parte do seu dia. Agora, queremos que você faça parte do nosso dia a dia.

Traga a sua energia para aLight !

title: Associate General Counsel for Faculty Affairs and Employment or a Senior Associate General Coun...
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

We are recruiting an Associate General Counsel for Faculty Affairs and Employment or a Senior Associate General Counsel, Faculty Affairs, Employment & Labor Relations. The selected incumbent provides in‑house legal counsel and strategic collaboration with Howard University and Howard University Hospital executives, academic administrators and the Office of Human Resources professionals regarding a comprehensive range of employment and labor relations matters. Advises and represents the University and Hospital on employment matters including but not limited to wrongful termination, discrimination, workers’ compensation and wage and hour claims brought by University and Hospital employees, including providing advice and counseling to University executives, academic administrators and Office of Human Resources professionals to ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations as well as advising on such matters in litigation.

Provides counsel and legal sufficiency review of legal documents, settlement agreements, discipline, suspensions, terminations, workplace policies, handbooks and other documents concerning employees. Supervises and manages outside counsel in employment and labor relations matters.

A candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel will have substantial labor experience, in addition to a strong foundation in an employment‑related practice. The Senior Associate General Counsel will provide in‑house legal counsel services and represents Howard University as the supervisor of the primary in‑house labor attorney handling all matters involving the bargaining units of the University and Hospital and related collective bargaining agreements.

Supervisory Accountability

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will not have any direct supervisory accountability, but is expected to be primarily responsible for all employment and faculty related matters with a high level of autonomy. The Senior Associate General Counsel will supervise all employment‑related and labor‑related work of other staff attorneys. Serves as supervisor of other in‑house counsel who will be first chair on labor, collective bargaining and union matters.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, and staff of the University. External contacts include federal and local courts and administrative agencies including EEOC, OHR, DOL and OWH.

Principal Accountabilities

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will have primary responsibilities to provide in‑house legal advice, interpretation, and representation in a broad range of legal issues with employment related matters with knowledge of the labor process. In addition, a candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel position will have supervisory responsibility for labor matters, including but not limited to representation in government agency investigations, grievances, arbitrations, and in cases before the National Labor Relations Board.

Responsibilities include reviewing and drafting workplace handbooks, policies and guidelines for legal sufficiency; providing review and recommendations regarding various regulatory and compliance matters. Other responsibilities include conducting formal training on EEO, wage & hour, mandated leave benefits, union representation, whistleblower, and other pertinent employment and labor law topics for new hires, current employees, and leadership. The incumbent also prepares legal documents such as offer letters, academic appointment contracts, settlement agreements, termination agreements, collective‑bargaining agreements, employment agreements. Also responsible for overseeing preparation of responses to information requests directed at Howard University or Hospital, advisory memoranda and documents relating to collective bargaining agreements, litigation matters or agency proceedings.

Represents the University in legal and quasi‑legal proceedings, including the District of Columbia and Federal courts and before government agencies on employment and labor relations matters and on other legal matters. Represents the University in hearings, meetings and in other forums related to University legal matters, as needed. Drafts and negotiates commitments involving University resources; principally contracts, settlements, other agreements and statements of University policy for subsequent approval by the General Counsel and University Officers. Reviews documents for other University offices for legal implications and possible legal policy questions. Responds to University officials’ request for advice in areas of assigned responsibility. Serves as office resource on updates and developments in employment and labor law.

Provides legal expertise and otherwise represents the office in meetings with University officials and individuals outside of the University. Provides counseling, advice, and guidance to academic administrators, supervisors and other management officials on faculty and staff conduct and performance problems. Provides assistance with conflict resolution, as requested. Furnishes recommendations to academic administrators, department heads, managers, and supervisors concerning possible courses of action in handling employee problems and concerns. Reviews employee discipline and discharge matters and makes recommendation for appropriate course of action. Reviews statistics and surveys and prepares analyses for review by the General Counsel. Reviews periodic utilization reports and develops appropriate management responses. Performs other job‑related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

Detailed knowledge of federal and local laws applicable to employment and labor relations, and judicial and administrative agency systems and procedures. Ability to conduct and manage adversarial proceedings on behalf of the University and Hospital before courts and administrative agencies. Ability to plan, direct and conduct independent legal research and related analyses on a variety of labor and employment law topics. Ability to participate effectively in fact‑finding investigations, present findings and develop related recommendations. Ability to articulate the University’s position, listen and negotiate effectively. Superior verbal and written communication skills. Ability to draft, review, revise and edit documents in Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Ability to identify possible need for action and to plan, supervise, and execute appropriate assignments with minimal guidance or supervision. Ability to work productively under pressure, to adhere to and enforce deadlines, and to project need for and effectuate team efforts required to meet deadlines. Ability to follow guidance and direction and to provide effective guidance and direction. Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students, University officials, union representatives and the general public.

Minimum Requirements

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will have a Juris Doctor from an accredited law school and six years of post J.D. legal experience which includes at least four years of substantial employment experience, with additional knowledge of the labor process. A candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel will have a Juris Doctor from an accredited law school and eight years of substantial labor and employment experience. All candidates must have a strong academic record; excellent oral and written communication skills. Membership or eligibility for membership in the District of Columbia Bar is required.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Salary Range

The anticipated salary for the Associate General Counsel position is $172,800.

The anticipated salary for the Senior Associate General Counsel position is $207,800.

Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

Descrição da vaga

A Supergasbras é uma empresa do grupo holandês SHV Energy, líder mundial na distribuição de Gás liquefeito de Petróleo (GLP), com mais de 100 anos de experiência. Nosso negócio é levar energia limpa e eficiente para milhões de brasileiros, seja nas suas casas, comércios, indústrias ou agronegócio. Os mais de 76 anos de atuação no Brasil nos posiciona como uma das principais distribuidoras nacionais de GLP - comercializamos cerca de 1,5 milhão de toneladas do produto por ano com aproximadamente 20% de participação de mercado.

Desenvolvemos uma série de projetos com foco em transformação digital, experiência do cliente, inovação e desenvolvimento sustentável do negócio. Nossa estratégia é conseguir através da confiança e integridade, ser a melhor empresa de Energia do Brasil para nossos clientes, parceiros, colaboradores e acionistas, com responsabilidade socioambiental.

Diversidade e inclusão é uma prioridade de negócios para a Supergasbras. Valorizamos e acreditamos no desenvolvimento de pessoas, tanto no contexto profissional como pessoal, tendo como estratégia a equidade de gênero, inclusão de pessoas com deficiência, respeito a todas as orientações sexuais e luta contra a discriminação racial nas diferentes camadas da sociedade.

Ser diverso é ser Super!

Esta oportunidade também está publicada no portal global de vagas da SHV Energy e faz parte do nosso compromisso de atrair talentos que compartilham dos nossos valores, independente da localização.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Objetivo do Cargo:

Atuar na coordenação de projetos estratégicos, com exposição à liderança executiva local e Holding. Este profissional será responsável pela elaboração, monitoramento e reporte de estudos de viabilidade econômica-financeira de projetos estratégicos para suportar a tomada de decisão da alta liderança.

Esta é uma oportunidade para profissionais hands‑on, com capacidade analítica e ceticismo profissional, que buscam desafios em um ambiente dinâmico, transformacional e orientado a resultados.

Responsabilidades:

  • Conduzir estudos de viabilidade econômica-financeira para iniciativas estratégicas, por meio de métricas de avaliação, tais como: fluxo de caixa descontado, TIR, payback, ROCE e cenários de sensibilidade.
  • Atuar como business partner das áreas de negócios junto aos gestores das iniciativas estratégicas no acompanhamento da performance financeira, com visão crítica, perfil colaborativo, comunicação clara e articulada.
  • Elaborar memorando técnico referente ao estudo de viabilidade financeira de investimentos em projetos específicos (significativos) para análise e aprovação pelo comitê executivo da Holding.
  • Monitorar, analisar e reportar o desempenho econômico‑financeiro das iniciativas estratégicas e investimento em projetos específicos, com base na análise das variações entre Forecast x Planejado, bem como assegurar a aderência às políticas e normas de investimento da Holding.

  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e dashboards executivos, bem como apresentações para reuniões de diretoria e comitês local e Holding.
  • Automatizar e otimizar processos da área por meio de ferramentas, tais como: Power BI e recursos de inteligência artificial (IA).

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia Produção e Contabilidade.
  • Vasta experiência em FP&A, investimentos, estratégia, projetos, M&A ou áreas correlatas.
  • Vivência em projetos multidisciplinares, envolvendo diferentes áreas e stakeholders.

  • Domínio de metodologias de análise de investimentos (TIR, payback, ROCE, FCD).

  • Inglês avançado, com capacidade de leitura, escrita e comunicação.
  • Power BI (intermediário/avançado).

  • Atração & Seleção: Entender as demandas das áreas clientes, apoiando gestores na definição de cargos, perfis e requisitos das vagas; acompanhar processos de recrutamento e seleção, garantindo alinhamento com as necessidades do negócio e SLAs acordados.

  • Performance, Carreira e Sucessão: Executar e suportar os ciclos de avaliação de desempenho, por meio de reuniões com gestores e colaboradores, fóruns de equalização e reconhecimento, assegurando direcionamento claro para evolução e meritocracia; apoiar movimentações internas e decisões de carreira; participar do mapeamento de posições críticas e sucessores, por meio de reuniões e atualizações em sistemas, garantindo continuidade dos negócios e desenvolvimento de talentos; fornecer suporte consultivo aos gestores, fortalecendo seu papel como protagonistas na gestão de pessoas.

  • Orçamento de Pessoas e Governança: Acompanhar a elaboração, controle e revisões do orçamento anual de pessoas das áreas clientes, incluindo headcount, movimentações salariais, meritocracia e provisões, por meio de análises, relatórios e alinhamentos com lideranças e áreas parceiras, assegurando aderência às diretrizes financeiras, políticas internas e estratégias do negócio.
  • Desligamento: Apoiar gestores nos processos de desligamento, garantindo alinhamento com políticas e boas práticas de RH; conduzir entrevistas de desligamento, analisando dados e gerando insights para identificação de oportunidades de melhoria e definição de planos de ação quando necessário.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência prévia como Business Partner.
  • Conhecimento intermediário em sistemas de RH (como SuccessFactors), Excel avançado e ferramentas básicas de análise de dados.
  • Inglês Avançado.

Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set-up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high-quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large-scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament-time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in-line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision-making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train-the-Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost-effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close-out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross-functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large-scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master’s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large-scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi-stakeholder and multicultural environments.

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A idéia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A idéia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

-Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Safety Engineer to join the Saudi Aramco Loss Prevention organization (LP).

LP is responsible for providing both day-to-day in-field occupational and process safety support to Saudi Aramco operations, as well as centralized technical support and consulting function. Our field offices are located in Abqaiq, Riyadh, Ras Tanura, Dhahran, Udhailiyah, Jeddah (including Yanbu and Jazan), and Tanajib. Through these offices, LP provides its services to all Saudi Aramco facilities and departments that are located throughout the Kingdom.

Your primary is to provide daily support to company facilities and departments, help them to effectively implement the Saudi Aramco Safety Management System (Occupational & Process Safety) expectations and associated programs, as well as to assure compliance to all company safety requirements.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Facilitate implementation of the Saudi Aramco Safety Management System, as well as its objectives and expectations, including developing associated safety processes, and participating in self-assessments.
  • Conduct field inspections/reviews to assess compliance to company and international codes and standards, identify safety concerns, formulate solutions, and develop practical and cost-effective corrective actions.
  • Identify, evaluate, recommend actions, and follow up on critical, yet universal safety tasks and control methodologies related to operational safety practices (e.g., work at height, isolation/LOTO, permit to work, hydrogen sulfide, confined space entry, excavations).
  • Participate in safety studies/activities using risk assessment and mitigation methodologies, such as: PHAs, HAZOPs, JSAs, incident investigations, compliance reviews, or insurance surveys.
  • Respond to emergency situations and incidents, either during or after regular working hours, to provide technical assistance and advice.
  • Participate in worksite contractor safety management activities (e.g., contractor selection and prequalification, monitoring of work site compliance, and measurement of performance).
  • Support the reporting, classification and investigation all incidents, and participating in incident investigations, determination of root causes, and proper recommendations to prevent recurrence.
  • Deliver Loss Prevention-specific training to employees, contractors, and outside parties.
  • Mentor other LP personnel.
  • As the successful candidate, you will hold a Bachelor degree in Engineering or Engineering Technology from an Accredited Institution,
  • You will have 7 years of experience as a safety professional in the oil and gas, petrochemicals or related industries. Your experience should be comprehensive, covering both occupational and process safety.
  • You will have an excellent ability to communicate in English with peers as well as members of management, and be able to produce clear and concise oral and written reports in English.

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Descrição da vaga

Nossa cultura está em constante transformação. Honramos nossa história e os sonhos grandes que nos trouxeram até aqui, mas seguimos evoluindo com a nossa gente, guiados por valores como Escuta Ativa, Colaboração e Visão de Longo Prazo. Queremos ser cada vez mais inclusivos, diversos, tecnológicos e conectados com o futuro.

Se você se vê trabalhando dentro de uma cervejaria, refrigeranteira, maltaria ou fábrica verticalizada, esse é o mundo ideal para você ! Atuar no nosso ecossistema de Supply Chain vai muito além de processo de fabricação e distribuição de cerveja. Estamos presentes em toda cadeia, do campo ao copo, NADA NOS PARA!

Prazer, somos a Ambev e adoraríamos te ter com a gente. Vamos juntos?!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Operar máquinas e equipamentos conforme padrões e rotinas de produção.
  • Manter o funcionamento dos equipamentos da unidade.
  • Realizar limpeza da linha de produção e dos equipamentos seguindo normas e procedimentos.

  • Utilizar EPIs corretamente e participar de treinamentos e palestras corporativas.
  • Realizar setup, regulagens e pequenos ajustes mecânicos.
  • Monitorar parâmetros de processo (volume, pressão, temperatura, velocidade, etc.).
  • Realizar inspeções visuais e controles de qualidade durante o envase.
  • Preencher registros de produção e relatórios operacionais.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação: Ensino médio completo.
  • Desejável experiência em operação de máquinas enchedoras (processo de envase)
  • Escala de trabalho 6x2, disponibilidade para atuar no turno B: 13H às 23H
  • Experiência em indústria de bebidas será um diferencial.
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e trabalho em equipe.
  • Responsabilidade e proatividade.
  • Perfil com sede de aprendizado.
  • Residir na cidade do Rio de Janeiro.

Informações adicionais

  • Mais cuidado com a sua saúde através de Plano Médico, Odontológico, Telemedicina, Seguro de Vida e WellHub
  • Saúde mental com a Telemedicina Dasa
  • Consumir nossos produtos com um super desconto (é isso mesmo, nós temos venda de produtos para funcionários no precinho!)
  • Reuniões de final de ano com a família ainda mais prazerosas, pois oferecemos Cesta de Natal e ainda brinquedo para quem tem filhos
  • Proteção financeira com a nossa Previdência Privada
  • Unidades com restaurantes próprios para suas refeições, subsidiados pela companhia.
  • O vale transporte e/ou Fretado, dependendo da sua unidade e localização
  • Ter a oportunidade de receber um abono assiduidade, que nada mais é do que um 14º salário para nossos colaboradores, um salário extra no ano!
  • Auxílio Creche ou Auxílio babá
  • Participação dos Lucros da companhia

Além de sonhar, se desenvolver, construir e crescer dentro de um ambiente meritocrático e inclusivo e ser capaz de fazer a diferença unindo as pessoas por um mundo melhor!

Seja bem-vindo à Ambev.

ENTRE PARA UM TIME QUE SONHA TÃO GRANDE COMO VOCÊ!

Somos milhares de apaixonados e apaixonadas pelo que fazemos. Temos um orgulho imenso do nosso poder de impacto positivo e reconhecemos que, agindo como donos e donas, cada um de nós desempenha um papel fundamental no sucesso do nosso ecossistema. Somado a isso, todas nossas grandes conquistas tem o sabor da colaboração! Nosso sucesso é compartilhado e acreditamos que por meio da colaboração podemos encantar ainda mais os nossos clientes com as marcas que eles amam hoje, ao mesmo tempo em que podemos atender aos gostos de amanhã.

A Nossa Cultura é focada em construir um ambiente inclusivo e colaborativo, onde as pessoas possam ser o melhor delas mesmas - e nos ajudar a ser a nossa melhor versão! Procuramos gente com paixão, curiosidade e coragem para fazer a diferença aqui.

Acolhemos talentos diversos, porque acreditamos que grandes ideias vêm de pessoas com diferentes trajetórias. Oferecemos oportunidades para talentos que estão ingressando no mercado de trabalho e somos apaixonados por impulsionar a nossa gente.

É trabalhando e crescendo juntos que atingimos o nosso propósito: Sonhamos Grande por um Futuro com Mais Razões para Brindar!

title: Analista de Admissões de Alunos (Customer Success) - Botafogo/RJ
description:
O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

SOBRE A VAGA

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade.Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Nesse papel sua missão principal será acompanhar todo o processo de admissão de novos alunos da unidade, focado na jornada da família, no relacionamento com a equipe pedagógica e nos sistemas de acompanhamento de dados.

RESPONSABILIDADES

O que você fará:

  • Conversão: ser o principal ponto focal para organizar e gerir os indicadores do funil e criar planos de ação; também, acompanhar o processo de matrícula e lidar com os sistemas necessários.
  • Retenção: acompanhar junto a equipe pedagógica as evasões, gerar indicadores e planos de ação para retenção, além de acompanhar ativamente o processo de rematrícula.
  • Captação: auxiliar nos eventos de captação, bem como apresentar a escola para grupos interessados e acompanhar as demandas de mercado para a escola. Firmar parcerias com outras instituições e escolas.

Além disso, você poderá:

  • Atender famílias interessadas em conhecer a escola, por e-mail e telefone.
  • Realizar entrevistas individuais com responsáveis interessados.
  • Planejar e executar ações de captação de novos alunos.
  • Conduzir visitas nas instalações da escola.
  • Aplicar avaliações.
  • Dar suporte nas apresentações pedagógicas.

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

REQUISITOS

O que você precisa ter:

  • Graduação completa.
  • Experiência com atendimento ao cliente.
  • Muita energia e gostar de um ambiente de ritmo acelerado.
  • Excel avançado.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Possuir experiência em gestão de CRM, coleta e análise de dados.
  • Inglês fluente.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

title: Grants - Senior Training Coordinator
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The purpose of this position is to provide primary coordination and facilitation of training and education programs affiliated with the MidAtlantic AIDS Education and Training Center Howard University Regional Partner, and the College of Pharmacy. Assures compliance with the scope of work, HRSA guidance, and serves as a Training Coordinator for all activities planned by the project, including needs assessment, data collection, and programming for all projects, including: Core, Minority AIDS Initiative, CDC, Inter‑Professional Education, Practice Transformation, Ending the HIV Epidemic and COVID-19.

Supervisory Authority

Involves no responsibility or authority for the direction of others.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include executives, administrators and employees from all divisions and departments within the university structure. External contacts include auditors, representatives from federal, state and local regulatory agencies and vendors.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Monitor evaluate and record training activities and program effectiveness. Setup and coordinate HIV‑related topic training programs to help DC Metropolitan healthcare professionals maintain or improve job skills. Assess training needs through surveys, interviews with employees, focus groups, or consultation with managers, instructors or customer representatives.
  • Develop alternative training methods if expected improvements are not seen. Organize and develop, or obtain, training procedure manuals and guides and course materials such as handouts and visual materials.
  • Organizing and facilitating monthly video conference calls, in person meetings, training events
  • Present information, using a variety of instructional techniques and formats such as role playing, simulations, team exercises, group discussions, videos and lectures.
  • Evaluate training materials prepared by trainers/subject matter experts such as outlines, text, and handouts.
  • Design, plan, organize and direct orientation and training for employees or customers of industrial or commercial establishment. Monitor training costs to ensure budget is not exceeded and prepare budget reports to justify expenditures. Select and assign instructors to conduct training.
  • Works with subcontractors to ensure the programs are developed that identify training needs, and effectively reach targeted audience and enhance the quality of education. Manages the certification process for continuing education credits for the designated professions.
  • Increases the center’s participation in collaborative efforts among varied professional organizations, pharmaceuticals, community‑based organization, professional schools and state and local government agencies.
  • Participates in all conferences and communications to subcontracts.
  • Supports the efforts of the department in organizing, maintaining and appropriate documentation to the Department Chair and Associate Dean of the school or department.
  • Maintaining files for the various MidAtlantic AIDS Education and Training Center projects and helping organize all required documentation to and from our funders and regional partner sites.
  • Meets Program Quarterly goals and creates reports for internal staff regarding programmatic activities.
  • Create training schedules for all programs, track and create reports on outcomes of all training and maintain training records for the department.
  • Attend seminars and meetings to learn new training methods and techniques and use the knowledge to prepare and coordinate future training sessions.
  • Recruit new speakers.
  • Prepare and submit speaker contracts to the Regional Coordinator.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with community‑based agencies, local, and state government.
  • Prepare and submit monthly reports on projects outcome and related activities.
  • Enter all technical assistance and activities in the database.
  • Provide customized coaching at the clinical site (e.g., CIDMAR) by working with the site to identify site‑specific needs and opportunities, prioritizing areas of focus, and identifying available and needed resources.
  • Address barriers to effective implementation of improvement processes; propose solutions for practices/health centers to consider in addressing barriers.
  • Advise individual clinical sites on the implementation of the interventions and measures, sharing specific best practice examples.
  • Serve as an active member of a practice transformation learning collaborative group.
  • Interact and collaborate with other practice coaches and planning groups. Receive training on practice coaching and the interventions and tools for site implementation.
  • Ensure implementation fidelity. Transparently share challenges and barriers regarding site implementation and share solutions for effectively implementing the interventions.
  • Work within the learning collaborative group to further refine the interventions, measures, and associated tools. Research and develop innovative ideas for future spread of best practices.
  • Create and/or assist in the creation of materials and presentations and assist with logistical coordination of training events.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge of the principles and procedures related to HIV education and training.
  • Ability to develop curriculum for programs.
  • Ability to use standard office equipment, which includes a computer and projector.
  • Ability to analyze and develop action plans in resolving and/or implementing organizational and operational problems, issues and goals.
  • Competence in both oral and written English to communicate in a clear and concise manner.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students and customers.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree in related field with 2‑5 years of related experience. 10 years of related work experience may be substituted in lieu of educational qualifications.

Note: This position description should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as may be required. The university has the right to revise this position

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$55,000-$65,000

title: Programa de Estágio ERM 2026
description:
Na ERM, moldamos um futuro sustentável com as principais organizações do mundo. Somos a maior consultoria global dedicada a sustentabilidade, com mais de 50 anos de história, 160 escritórios em mais de 40 países, empregando mais de 8.000 pessoas.

Com 5 escritórios, 500 profissionais e mais de 30 anos de atuação no Brasil, trabalhamos com clientes de diversos setores para ajudá-los a entender e gerenciar seus impactos ambientais, sociais, climáticos e de saúde e segurança, riscos e sociais. Atendemos centenas de clientes em Petróleo e Gás, Mineração, Energia, Indústria, Química, Farmacêutica, Agro e Finanças, entre outros.

Estamos abrindo oportunidades para estágio em Consultoria na área de Finanças Sustentáveis / ESG em nossos escritórios localizados em São Paulo e Rio de Janeiro, em regime híbrido, com carga horária de 30h semanais.

Finanças Sustentáveis

Na área de Finanças Sustentáveis, aconselhamos tomadores de decisão a incorporar a sustentabilidade nas decisões financeiras e de alocação de capital por meio de:

  • avaliação do desempenho em sustentabilidade de empresas, ativos e instrumentos financeiros;
  • assessoria a agentes financeiros sobre estratégia e implementação de processos e ferramentas;
  • apoio a governos, reguladores e sociedade civil na melhoria do ambiente de negócios para fluxos financeiros sustentáveis.

Quem vier estagiar aqui será alocado em uma equipe atuante em uma dessas frentes, com possibilidade de troca a cada ano de estágio. Vai interagir com outras pessoas estagiárias, analistas, consultores e especialistas para a realização dos projetos junto aos clientes.

Perfil de Estagiário

  • Interesse pelas temáticas ESG (Ambiental, Social e de Governança), finanças e negócios;
  • Curiosidade, proatividade e vontade de aprender;
  • Habilidade para expressar ideias, tanto por escrito quanto verbalmente;
  • Espírito de equipe e perfil colaborativo;
  • Atenção aos detalhes e organização;
  • Comprometimento e responsabilidade.

Requisitos

  • Pacote Office intermediário (foco Excel e Power Point);
  • Inglês suficiente para leitura e escrita, e muita disposição para evoluir em conversação (temos muitos projetos internacionais);
  • Previsão de formatura entre Jun/2027 e Jun/2028;
  • Formações preferenciais: Administração; Economia; Engenharia de Produção; Relações Internacionais, Gestão Ambiental ou áreas correlatas;
  • Disponibilidade para 30h semanais em regime híbrido.

Atividades em Estágio em Finanças Sustentáveis

  • Pesquisar e analisar indicadores de desempenho ambiental, social e de governança corporativa de empresas de capital aberto ou emissoras de dívida;
  • Dar suporte em avaliação de produtos financeiros sustentáveis (títulos verdes, fundos de investimento verdes etc.);
  • Avaliar a conformidade de empresas com legislação socioambiental e padrões de sustentabilidade (ex. Padrões de Desempenho do IFC, Objetivos de Desenvolvimento Sustentável);
  • Realizar pesquisas sobre tendências ambientais, sociais e climáticas e seus impactos econômicos;
  • Mapear processos e apoiar no entendimento de desafios de negócios reais;
  • Dar suporte na elaboração de apresentações para clientes (Power Point);
  • Elaborar relatórios sobre temas ESG;
  • Desenvolver ferramentas em Excel;
  • Apoiar a realização de entrevistas e apresentações com clientes e parceiros.

title: Lead Software Engineer / Tech Lead, Growth (Remote)
description:
Fully Remote (North America / South America)

  • There is 1 opening, posted to multiple locations.

No agencies.

About Maximus

Maximus ( is a mission-driven consumer performance medicine telehealth company that provides men and women with content, community, and clinical support to optimize their health, wellness, and hormones. Maximus has achieved profitability, 8-figure ARR, and is doubling year over year - with a strong cash position. We have raised $15M from top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors/operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, & Shopify.

We also offer Maximus Labs, a standalone biomarker testing subscription that doubles as an acquisition channel into our telemedicine protocols. We're targeting 2x customer growth this year and need a Growth Lead who can build the acquisition engine that gets us there.

We're capital-efficient and compete against Hims, Hone, Keeps, and Fella by being better at the product, not louder with ad spend. Our growth strategy is conversion-driven: make the signup-to-checkout funnel so good that paid channels become more efficient by default.

About the Role

We are looking for a strong Lead Engineer (Tech Lead) to lead our Growth engineering team. You will be splitting your time roughly 50/50 between management and coding. You own the lower acquisition funnel, from flow start through checkout, across all Maximus protocols.

Your north star metric is Flow Start to Checkout CVR. You also carry an M1 Retention guardrail, which means you can't optimize for conversion at the expense of user quality. Every experiment you ship has a built-in quality check.

You will manage a small team of engineers and work directly with a Sr. PM and Sr. Designer. You will report directly to the Head of Engineering.

What you will do (Key Responsibilities):

  • Deliver protocol-level A/B experiments on signup flows, checkout, plan pricing, and product recommendations using Amplitude
  • Ship full-stack features across the acquisition funnel in Rails and React
  • Coach and develop your engineering team through regular 1:1s, pair programming, code reviews, and career conversations
  • Own experiment design, including sample sizing, metric selection, and the CVR-vs-retention tension that comes with a dual mandate
  • Iterate and continuously optimize plan and pricing architecture, including payment platform integrations
  • Build and maintain the experimentation infrastructure your team runs on
  • Partner with data engineering to instrument cohort-level M1 retention tracking per experiment
  • Drive adoption of AI-assisted development across the team, using tools like Claude Code and Devin to increase shipping and development velocity

Our Tech Stack:

  • Ruby on Rails 7 / Ruby 3.3, React 18 / TypeScript 5.4 (required)
  • Event-sourced architecture with command pattern
  • PostgreSQL, Redis, Delayed Job for background processing
  • Stripe and Klarna for payments and installment plans
  • Amplitude for experimentation and analytics, Segment for event collection
  • Redux with redux-loop and Immutable.js on the frontend
  • Docker, AWS/GCP, Aptible, GitHub Actions CI/CD
  • Cypress for E2E testing
  • AI-assisted development: Claude Code and Devin for agentic coding

What we are looking for (Qualifications):

  • You've led a team of 4-8 engineers before, with direct reports you grew and retained
  • You've shipped and measured growth experiments in a subscription product (signup funnels, checkout optimization, pricing and plan architecture)
  • You write production Ruby on Rails and React code and expect to keep doing so (strongly preferred). Javascript (Node), Python are also acceptable.
  • You can design an experiment, pick the right metric, set a sample size, and explain the trade-offs to a PM who wants to ship faster
  • You think in funnels and cohorts, not just features
  • You're comfortable with event-sourced systems or similar architectural patterns where state is derived from event streams
  • You use agentic AI coding tools (Claude Code, Devin, Cursor, or similar) in your daily workflow and have opinions about how to integrate them into a team's development process

Nice to have (strongly preferred):

  • Experience with healthcare, wellness, or regulated subscription commerce
  • Familiarity with Stripe billing, Klarna, or similar payment platform integrations
  • Experience building or managing Amplitude (or LaunchDarkly, Optimizely, etc.) experimentation infrastructure

How we work:

  • Remote, Americas-based (team is distributed across US and Latin America time zones)
  • Two-week sprints with PM, Design, and Tech Lead driving prioritization together
  • Ship and deploy to production multiple times per day

Why this role and join us?

You’ll set the technical direction for how Maximus acquires customers, run experiments that directly move revenue, and build a team that compounds learning over time. The Growth team's output is visible in the company's top-line numbers every month.

Maximus is at the stage where the acquisition engine needs a dedicated engineering leader who stays with the problem long enough to compound results. If you want to own that end to end, with real authority and real accountability, this is the role for you.

World-Class Benefits:

  • Flexible vacation/time-off policies
  • Equity into the company in the form of high potential stock options
  • Liquidity of options whenever available
  • Extended options exercise window for loyal employees (3 months for every year of service; e.g. 1 year for 4+ year employees)

Interview process

Do you believe you're a fit for this role and want to join the Maximus team? We'd love to hear about you! Here is what you can expect from the hiring process (if there are changes we will be sure to let you know).

Please refrain from messaging or emailing people directly, if you are interested, apply directly, your application will be reviewed by a human.

  1. Application & Criteria Questionnaire: When submitting your application and resume, tell us why you want to join Maximus and take your time with the questions. The Criteria Questionnaire will be sent to you automatically and is mandatory, we will use it as part of our data driven process. This is your chance to make a strong first impression.
  2. First Interview: Interview with Justin L, Recruiting Lead. This will be a exploratory conversation focused on how you work, your experience & fit for the role, and alignment on values and expectations.
  3. Role Interview: You will then meet with Mark P - Head of Engineering and Steve C - Senior Growth Product Manager to understand how you would approach real Growth team problems across system design, product trade-offs, and compliance.
  4. Technical Interview: Interview with one of our Senior or Lead engineers to evaluate hands‑on coding ability in our stack (Rails + React/TypeScript). We want to see that you can build and ship, not just architect. Feel free use agentic AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, etc.) during the exercise, as appropriate
  5. Leadership Interview: Chat with Mark P - Head of Engineering on leading a team, growing engineers, hiring and other aspects of people leadership.
  6. Meet the CEO: At the very end, you will have the opportunity to meet with Cam S, our CEO. This is a great chance for you to gain a deeper understanding of Maximus's strategy, values, and work processes.

Maximus is an equal opportunity employer, which not only includes standard protected categories, but the additional freedom from discrimination against your free speech and beliefs, as long as they are aligned with company values. We celebrate intellectual diversity.

Note: We utilize AI note-taking technology during our interview sessions to ensure we capture all answers and details accurately. Candidates are also encouraged to use AI note-takers for their own records if they wish.
