description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Responsible for the successful implementation of the Media Services at the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.

Media Operations & Services is a very important function in the organisation, as this area is providing the services and conditions for all media to report about the competition to millions of viewers, listeners and readers around the world.

Reporting organisationally to the Head of Media Operations & Services, the Senior Media Services Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team, and work in close collaboration with Accreditation, Accommodation, Transport, Catering, Venue Management, Media partnerships, Host City Rights Management and other key individuals responsible for planning, delivering and managing Media services for the more than 2000 national and international media expected to attend the FIFA Women’s World Cup. Success with this project will contribute favourably to the positive outcome of the Women’s Football Strategy .

Key responsibilities

  • Support to implement a comprehensive media servicing strategy for all Brazil host cities of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure consistent delivery of services across various tournament venues, ensuring a standardised experience for all media professionals.
  • Support to define an efficient visa strategy and implementation of visa procedure for media representatives.
  • Coordinate with logistics to define appropriate custom procedures for media representatives to bring professional equipment in and out of the host country.
  • Support the accreditation process in collaboration with the FIFA Zurich Media Operations & Services team and the Accreditation team.
  • Plan transport services for media representatives across all tournament venues.
  • Support FIFA Zurich HQ to coordinate media Accommodation options and scope services linked to it in collaboration with Media partnership
  • Support in the implementation of Media Ticketing.
  • Support in facilitating a seamless integration between media operations and media services, optimising workflows to deliver the highest level of support and services to accredited media representatives.
  • Support to create a uniformed pricing strategy for catering services.
  • Support to create inventive and budget-conscious media gift and incentive ideas tailored for accredited media representatives.

Your profile

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent
  • Higher education qualification in media or sports event management
  • 5+ years’ experience in the sports industry, with an emphasis on media and broadcast operations
  • 5-7 years’ experience in sports project management, preferably in football
  • Fluent in English, Portuguese, Spanish and/or French proficiency is a plus
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15 ,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipal, e R$ 24 ,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

BS degree in any of the following: Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Information Systems, or Computer Systems Engineering or equivalent years of experience.

O objetivo do Analista Sênior de Tesouraria é garantir a integridade, conformidade e eficiência das operações de tesouraria da afiliada dentro de um ambiente regulatório e bancário complexo. A posição gerencia fluxos de caixa, relacionamentos bancários, autorizações de pagamentos e obrigações financeiras, assegurando conformidade com normas do Banco Central e controles internos. Ready to leverage your scientific expertise to contribute to the growth and visibility of a global leader in preclinical research?

QIMA Life Sciences is looking for a Marketing Project Leader – Brazil to join our Marketing team. You will be responsible for developing and implementing the B2B communication and marketing strategy targeting pharma and biotech sponsors, positioning our services as key partners in analytical and clinical development for both branded and generic drugs on the Brazilian and international markets.

We are seeking a scientifically driven professional, eager to grow into a strategic role at the crossroads of marketing, scientific communication, and business development.

  • Inbound marketing: manage web pages (PT/EN), write SEO‑optimized articles, produce newsletters and email campaigns, and contribute to lead generation.

  • Monitorar, analisar e reportar KPIs de Manutenção, tais como disponibilidade física, MTBF, MTTR, aderência ao plano de manutenção, custos e índice de falhas críticas.

  • Assegurar o cumprimento das normas de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente (SMS), procedimentos corporativos e regulamentações aplicáveis ao ambiente offshore.
  • Apoiar investigações de falhas, análises de causa raiz (RCA) e implementação de ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Gerenciarcontratose atividades de empresas terceirizadas, garantindo conformidade técnica, prazos, qualidade e segurança dos serviços executados.
  • Desenvolver tecnicamente a equipe, promovendotreinamentos, padronização de boas práticas e melhoria contínua dos processos de manutenção.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Function

Full‑time laboratory research position in Alzheimer’s disease and related dementia (ADRD). Key responsibilities include:

  • Conduct experiments utilizing various techniques specific to the laboratory to investigate mechanisms and treatment strategies of ADRD. Maintain detailed and accurate records of experimental procedures and results.
  • Collect, maintain, analyze, and interpret experimental data using appropriate statistical and analytical methods. Contribute to the preparation of research presentations and manuscripts.
  • Participate in lab meeting seminars, and collaborative research discussions.
  • Assist with general lab maintenance and organization, including ordering supplies and ensuring compliance with safety regulations.

Supervisory Authority

Host laboratory mentors and program leadership provide supervisory authority for HU-ERA-PREP Scholars. Fellows will report to assigned research mentors at host labs, who will provide direct oversight, mentorship and project management including ensuring accurate documentation and presentation of research activities and findings. Research supervisors will enforce compliance with institutional policies ethical guidelines and safety regulations. Regular performance evaluations will be conducted to provide constructive feedback, identify areas for improvement as well as recognize exceptional performance and contributions.

Nature And Scope

Fellows will engage in advanced research focused on mechanisms underlying Alzheimer’s disease or related dementias including preventative and treatment strategies. This position offers a unique opportunity for recent graduates to gain hands‑on research experience and contribute to high‑impact projects in a collaborative and supportive environment.

Principal Accountabilities

title: Observatório Nacional lança edital do Programa Meninas Cientistas
description:
Observatório Nacional lança edital do Programa Meninas Cientistas

Programa oferece iniciação científica em geofísica e astronomia para meninas do ensino médio de escolas públicas no Rio de Janeiro.

O Observatório Nacional (ON), vinculado ao Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, lançou no dia 11 deste mês o edital do Programa ‘Meninas Cientistas do ON’, em celebração ao Dia Internacional de Mulheres e Meninas na Ciência. A iniciativa é destinada exclusivamente a estudantes do ensino médio que se identificam com o gênero feminino, marcando a primeira vez que a instituição cria um programa de iniciação científica dedicado à formação de meninas na ciência.

O objetivo principal é despertar a vocação científica e tecnológica em jovens, incentivando novos talentos e proporcionando contato direto com métodos e técnicas de pesquisa. O programa estimula o desenvolvimento do pensamento científico, da criatividade e da capacidade de resolução de problemas por meio de projetos supervisionados por pesquisadores do ON. Essa ação integra as políticas institucionais do Observatório Nacional para promover a diversidade e a equidade de gênero na ciência, alinhadas a iniciativas internacionais que buscam maior participação feminina em áreas científicas e tecnológicas.

Nesta primeira edição, o edital selecionará duas equipes de pesquisa: uma na área de geofísica e outra em astronomia. Cada equipe será composta por uma professora orientadora e quatro alunas da mesma instituição pública de educação básica, reconhecida pelo MEC e localizada no Rio de Janeiro. A professora é responsável por selecionar as estudantes e realizar a inscrição da equipe pelo link oficial.

As equipes selecionadas desenvolverão atividades científicas com supervisão direta de pesquisadores do Observatório Nacional, dedicando quatro horas semanais ao projeto: de uma a duas horas no campus do ON, em São Cristóvão, e o restante na própria escola. O edital prevê bolsas de R$ 300 mensais para cada aluna e R$ 500 mensais para a professora orientadora, com o intuito de estimular a permanência das estudantes nas atividades e fortalecer a formação em áreas estratégicas para o país.

As inscrições estão abertas, e as equipes interessadas devem consultar o cronograma oficial no site do programa para prazos de submissão, avaliação e divulgação de resultados.

Job description

O Opportunity é uma das primeiras empresas em gestão independente de recursos criada no Brasil. Nossa história é marcada pela vanguarda, excelência e protagonismo no mercado financeiro brasileiro.

Atuamos em quatro grandes segmentos:

Asset Management: Gestão de fundos abertos com ampla plataforma de produtos e com consistência nos resultados;

Private Equity: Investimentos em empresas com participação ativa na gestão e estratégias de crescimento;

Real Estate: Investimentos imobiliários por todo território nacional e desenvolvimento de projetos imobiliários em áreas privilegiadas com total preservação do meio ambiente; e

Wealth Management: Aconselhamento independente e profissionalizado de gestão patrimonial.

A pessoa será responsável por estruturar dados, automatizar processos, desenvolver modelos de IA aplicáveis ao dia a dia da gestão e criar ferramentas que suportem a tomada de decisão.

É uma posição integrada ao time de investimentos, com autonomia para testar, propor e implementar soluções inovadoras.

Main responsibilities

  • Coleta, tratamento e organização de dados

Requirements and skills

  • Sólida experiência em Python.
  • Experiência em modelos de ML e/ou LLMs aplicados a problemas reais.
  • Conhecimento de SQL e bancos de dados.
  • Experiência com visualização de dados (Power BI, Streamlit).

  • Suporte a Soluções Digitais: apoiar no desenho, adaptação e evolução de soluções tecnológicas que atendam aos requisitos de compliance, garantindo usabilidade, escalabilidade e aderência regulatória.

  • Garantir evolução e melhorias para solução de GRC implementada.

Conhecimento, Experiência e Formação

  • Experiência em Governança, Riscos e Compliance (GRC)

  • Project Management no modelo Agile e tradicional Waterfall, e ferramentas de marcado como Azure Devops.
  • Experiência na plataforma Microsoft e gerenciar banco de dados como Power BI, PowrApps, Power Automate fundamental, Dataverse.
  • Experiência em soluções de IA como Copilot premium e Studio, e soluções de Multi-agentes.
  • Conhecimento em controles e requisitos de segurança da informação/Compliance.
  • Graduação em Sistemas da Informação, TI ou áreas correlatas.
  • Certificação em Riscos e Controles: CCSA (Certification in Control Self-Assessment), CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor), CRISC (Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control);
  • Certificação em Agile/Scrum (PSM, CSM) ou PMP com ênfase em metodologias ágeis;
  • Certificações Data Analytics, ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau);
  • Certificação em produtos Microsoft Power Platform Fundamentals.

Fundada em 20 de agosto de 1972, a Unimed do Estado do Rio de Janeiro – Federação Estadual das Cooperativas Médicas (Unimed Ferj) atua há 52 anos como representante estatutária de todas as Unimeds do estado. title: Reservoir Engineer - entry-level
description:
Job Summary

The Reservoir Engineer is responsible for assisting in delivery of safe, efficient, and reliable products and services to our customers. The job consults with operations groups as needed to support the area of expertise and identifies opportunities for continuous improvement of product and service delivery and formally communicates findings. The Reservoir Engineer actively participates in promoting new technology and services offerings and supports the PL in risk management and applying lessons learned to improve job design and execution as related to the area of expertise. They provide real-time support to operations as required.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Provide technical support in the area of expertise throughout the Sales and Product and Service Delivery process.
  • Assist as required with the development of technical job designs for PLs.
  • Assist with identifying areas where new and cost effective techniques can be applied.
  • Explore opportunities for value-added products and services.
  • Consult with Design/Technical Engineer role as required to optimize the technical design.
  • Assist in real-time incident response, recovery, and investigation as related to the area of expertise.
  • Assist in evaluating technical viability and overall appraisal of tenders as related to the area of expertise.
  • Remain current on new technologies.
  • Maintain customer visibility through active participation in professional society activities and calls for papers.
  • Understand the competition’s technical offering.
  • Participate in external technical societies and communities.
  • Contribute, write and review technical publications.
  • Engage with local universities, Customer institutes and research organizations.

Requirements

  • Academic Background: A bachelor's or master's degree in Petroleum Engineering, Reservoir Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Applied Mathematics or related field is expected.
  • Language: Intermediate/advanced English
  • Practical Experience: Previous experience in internships, research projects, or working in the oil and gas industry, especially in roles related to reservoir engineering and numerical simulation, would be highly valued.
  • Experience in Numerical Simulation: Proven experience in numerical simulation of reservoirs using specialized software such as Eclipse, Petrel or similar. This includes the ability to model the behavior of fluids in oil and gas reservoirs, simulate fluid flow in different scenarios, and interpret the results.
  • Knowledge of Programming Language: Strong proficiency in programming language, especially Python. This includes the ability to write scripts and programs to automate tasks, manipulate data, create analysis and visualization tools, and integrate different parts of the simulation workflow.
  • Knowledge in Geology and Reservoir Engineering: Solid understanding of the concepts of petroleum geology, reservoir engineering and oil recovery processes. This includes the ability to interpret geological and engineering data to create accurate reservoir models.
  • New energies and sustainability: desirable knowledge of numerical simulation applied to new energies and sustainability, such as carbon capture and storage.

Soft Skills

  • Analytical and Problem Solving Skills: Ability to analyze complex problems related to reservoir engineering, identify effective solutions and implement them efficiently.
  • Communication and Teamwork: Verbal and written communication skills are crucial for communicating results, collaborating with teammates and presenting technical information in a clear and concise manner.
  • Adaptability and Continuous Learning: Given the dynamic nature of the oil and gas industry and constant technological changes, it is important that the candidate demonstrates adaptability and willingness to continually learn new techniques and technologies.

title: Transportation Specialist, ROC
description:
ROC (Relay Operations Center) is the centralized command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, EU, India, Mexico, Brazil etc. It ensures hassle free, timely pick‑up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, ROC steps in to resolve the issues by keeping the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with tactical problem solving ROC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, ROC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.

Overview of a Transportation Specialist

A Transportation Specialist at ROC facilitates the flow of information between different stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impact customer experience and business continuity. The role works across two verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations. Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationships, ensuring that freight is picked‑up on time and delivered to FC as per the given appointment. Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationships, ensuring that the truck leaves the FC to deliver customer orders as per promise. A Transportation Specialist provides timely resolution by researching and querying internal tools, taking real‑time decisions, analyzing data, noticing trends, and driving customer experience without compromising on time. The ideal candidate should understand basic logistics, communicate clearly in written and oral form, ideate process improvements, and drive them to completion.

Responsibilities

  • Communicate with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
  • Provide real‑time customer experience in a 24/7 operating environment
  • Systematically escalate problems or variances in information and data to relevant owners and teams, and follow through on resolutions
  • Develop and/or understand performance metrics to assist with driving business results
  • Communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, to create narratives outlining weekly findings, variances to goals, and present these findings in a review forum
  • Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs, measuring and identifying activities performed
  • Quickly understand the business impact of trends and make decisions that make sense based on available data

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. We not only celebrate the diversity of our workforce, we celebrate the diverse ways we work. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

  • Experience with Excel
  • Excellent communication skills – both verbal and written

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SQL
  • Proficiency in English, both written and verbal communication skills

title: Last Mile Capacity Planning Specialist, AMZL Capacity Planning
description:
Job ID: | Amazon Logistica do Brasil

A equipe de planejamento de capacidade da AMZL fornece às operações soluções e planos para operações de estações de entrega e frota, durante todo o ano e durante os picos sazonais. O especialista em planejamento de capacidade apoia a execução diária das atividades de gerenciamento de capacidade, trabalhando na definição da capacidade operacional de cada estação de entrega, fazendo o trabalho analítico relacionado à execução e às métricas de capacidade “na estrada” e “sob o teto”. O(a) candidato(a) ideal é apaixonado(a) por usar dados para oferecer um plano prático que impacte os negócios. Ele/Ela têm um forte histórico de entrega de resultados e tem experiência na execução em um ambiente multifuncional, apoiado por análises e dados. Ele/Ela gosta de um ambiente acelerado, trabalhando com grandes quantidades de dados e resolvendo problemas altamente complexos e ambíguos.

Key Job Responsibilities

Como especialista em planejamento de capacidade, você trabalhará no monitoramento de volumes operacionais, trabalhando internamente com equipes da AMZL para garantir a capacidade operacional do plano semanal e diário, e também com outras equipes de transporte e FC para alinhar as configurações de capacidade das estações de entrega em todo o país. Você analisará as lacunas de capacidade versus plano e trabalhará para eliminá-las com as equipes de execução, otimizando o volume das estações de entrega. Você trabalhará em tarefas analíticas, investigando desvios nas premissas críticas de planejamento (pacotes por rota, tamanho médio de pacotes) e fazendo revisões para instruir as operações. Você trabalhará com as configurações de sistemas da Amazon, definindo a capacidade para cada tipo de operação e monitorando a utilização dessa capacidade definida.

O turno de trabalho para esta vaga funciona em escala 5x2, com folgas alternadas em dias de semana e fim de semana. A escala de trabalho é definida de forma o ocupante dessa vaga tenha folga aos domingos a cada 15 dias ou menos, tenha folga de 1 fim de semana inteiro por mês (sábado e domingo) e que não trabalhe mais do que 6 dias seguidos.

Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os “Amazonians” a oferecer os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Não só celebramos a diversidade de nossa força de trabalho, mas também as diversas formas de trabalhar. Se você quiser solicitar uma acomodação para o processo de entrevista ou integração, informe nossa equipe e nós o conectaremos à nossa equipe de acomodação.

A day in the life

  • Trabalhar com equipes da Amazon para transformar inputs de previsão de volume em plano de execução operacional;
  • Interagir com as partes interessadas em toda a malha AMZL para garantir que a execução do plano diário;
  • Apoiar a liderança com análises de dados importantes para garantir uma tomada de decisão rápida e precisa.

About the team

O Amazon Logistics (AMZL) é o serviço de entrega “Last Mile” da Amazon, responsável por entregar pacotes (e sorrisos) para residências e empresas em todo o planeta. Na AMZL Brasil, a equipe de Planejamento e Expansão (P&E) supervisiona três áreas principais de apoio à operação e crescimento da AMZL: (1) Planejamento e gerenciamento da jurisdição, impulsionando o crescimento e a otimização de nossa cobertura e topologia de entrega/coleta; (2) Planejamento de capacidade, garantindo capacidade adequada em curto/médio/longo prazo para maximizar a obtenção de volume dentro da jurisdição da AMZL; e (3) Iniciativas de expansão, coordenando esforços locais em projetos “grandes” que permitem novos tipos de operações, novos canais de vendas e entrega (tipos de frota, micromobilidade) e coordenação programática de ponta a ponta da expansão da rede da AMZL.

Qualifications

  • Graduação Completa;
  • Inglês Intermediário;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Microsoft Excel, incluindo: tabelas dinâmicas, macros, índice/correspondência, vlookup, VBA, links de dados, etc.
  • Conhecimento em SQL ou outras linguagens de programação de dados.

title: Collections Account Analyst
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Function

The Collections Counselor supports students with aging or past-due balances by providing clear, accurate, and compassionate financial guidance. The role conducts proactive outreach, explains payment options, resolves discrepancies, documents activity thoroughly, and collaborates with campus partners to help students regain good financial standing. The position ensures all counseling and communications align with university policies, federal regulations, and service quality standards.

Supervisory Accountability

None

Nature And Scope

The Collections Counselor serves as a frontline financial support specialist within Student Accounts, working directly with students whose balances require follow-up or repayment. The Counselor communicates regularly via phone, email, ticketing, and in-person appointments— occasionally during nontraditional hours—to explain account status, payment plans, holds, and next steps. The role requires strong communication skills, customer-service orientation, attention to detail, and the ability to support adult and traditional learners navigating financial challenges. The incumbent works closely with Collections Leads, Student Accounts Advisors, Cashiering Services, Financial Aid, the Registrar’s Office, Treasury, and other campus partners to resolve discrepancies, verify adjustments, and support the timely and accurate processing of payments. The Counselor reinforces university expectations while maintaining a student-centered, empathetic approach.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Conduct outreach to students with past-due balances to explain account status, payment requirements, repayment options, and consequences of nonpayment.
  • Provide empathetic, student-centered counseling on payment plans, outstanding charges, financial holds, and available resources.
  • Assist students with setting up, monitoring, and understanding payment plan terms, deadlines, and consequences for missed payments.
  • Conduct thorough account reviews, identify discrepancies, and escalate complex or unusual cases to the Collections Lead.
  • Process returned payments, verify financial adjustments, and coordinate with Financial Aid, Registrar, and Cashiering to ensure accurate account updates.
  • Maintain detailed documentation of all outreach, counseling sessions, follow-up actions, and resolutions in accordance with departmental policy.
  • Ensure compliance with FERPA, FDCPA, institutional procedures, and established scripts and communication standards.
  • Prepare routine reports and status updates to support monitoring of aging balances and collection activities.
  • Provide high-quality, professional customer service and reinforce university policy while helping students work toward financial stability.

Core Competencies

  • Demonstrates empathy, patience, and clarity when helping students in financial distress.
  • Accurately interprets account activity and identifies appropriate next steps.
  • Communicates clearly and concisely across phone, email, ticketing, and in-person interactions.
  • Works collaboratively with cross-campus partners to resolve issues efficiently.
  • Maintains accuracy in account reviews, documentation, and follow-through.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and supporting evening or nontraditional service hours.
  • Understands billing, collections, payment plan structures, financial aid interactions, and registration impacts.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; an equivalent combination of education and related experience may be considered.
  • Basic understanding of accounts receivable processess.
  • One to two years of experience in customer service, billing, student accounts, accounts receivable, financial aid, or another financial operations role.
  • Experience supporting adult learners or students facing financial hardship preferred.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain financial concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Ability to handle confidential information and comply with FERPA, FDCPA, and institutional guidelines.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze account data, identify discrepancies, and elevate complex issues appropriately.
  • Experience with ERP or student information systems (Workday preferred; training provided).
  • Proven ability to manage multiple cases, deadlines, and follow‑up tasks in a high‑volume environment.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Financial Aid, Cashiering, Registrar, Treasury, and other campus partners.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary Range: $63,000 - $70,000

Job Title: Business Development Representative (BDR)

Location: Remote

Department: Sales

Company Overview

Founded in early 2002, viaPeople set out to redefine the human resources software industry by adopting a unique business model. Unlike competitors that offered one‑size‑fits‑all solutions, we committed to developing best‑of‑breed products tailored to the distinct needs of our clients. Our approach combines expert‑driven design with exceptional flexibility to address even the most complex requirements, all while maintaining a steadfast focus on product excellence, relationship management, and superior service quality.

With over two decades of experience in optimizing people management, viaPeople delivers bespoke HR software solutions that adapt to client needs, supported by a reliable and responsive vendor. Our offerings include performance management, succession planning, and 360‑degree feedback solutions, all backed by an exceptional level of service.

Job Overview

The Business Development Representative (BDR) will be responsible for maintaining and scaling viaPeople’s sales engine. This role sits at the intersection of sales development, lead operations, and sales analytics.

You will own lead ingestion, enrichment, and sourcing efforts while partnering closely with sales leadership to ensure pipeline health, data quality, and visibility into performance. This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, data‑oriented, and motivated by building systems that enable consistent outbound success.

This is a foundational role on the growth team with clear exposure to sales strategy, tooling, and performance metrics.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Development & Lead Sourcing

  • Own inbound lead intake, qualification, routing, and enrichment
  • Proactively source new leads through research, outbound prospecting, and targeted account lists
  • Support outbound campaigns via email, LinkedIn, and other prospecting tools
  • Identify ideal customer profiles (ICPs) and buying personas in partnership with sales leadership

Sales Operations & Data Integrity

  • Maintain clean, accurate, and enriched CRM data
  • Ensure lead and account records are consistently updated and standardized
  • Track funnel performance from lead to opportunity
  • Identify gaps, bottlenecks, and drop‑off points in the sales process

Reporting & Dashboards

  • Build and maintain sales dashboards and reporting to track:
    • Lead volume and source
    • Conversion rates
    • Pipeline coverage
    • Activity metrics
  • Provide regular reporting and insights to sales leadership
  • Support forecasting and pipeline reviews with accurate data

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Sales, Marketing, and Leadership to align on pipeline goals
  • Provide feedback on lead quality and campaign effectiveness
  • Support Account Executives by ensuring qualified, well‑researched leads

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred (or equivalent experience)
  • 3 years of experience in BDR, SDR, sales operations, or revenue operations roles
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills with attention to detail
  • Experience working with CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar)
  • Comfortable working with spreadsheets, dashboards, and basic reporting
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Self‑starter who thrives in a fast‑moving, early‑growth environment
  • Interest in B2B SaaS, HR technology, or sales operations is a plus

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary Range: Competitive Compensation Package
  • Bonus: Performance‑based bonus tied to pipeline and data quality metrics
  • PTO: Generous unlimited PTO and holiday schedule
  • Growth Opportunity: Direct exposure to sales strategy, tooling decisions, and leadership

Why This Role Matters

This role is critical to ensuring viaPeople’s sales team operates with clarity, consistency, and momentum. You’ll help power the front end of the revenue engine while providing the insights leadership needs to scale efficiently.

Designed as a sanctuary of art, craftsmanship, and sensory experiences, the hotel sets a new benchmark for luxury hospitality in Rio de Janeiro.

The property features 172 rooms and suites with the signature Sofitel MyBed, refined art‑filled interiors, and sweeping views of Two Brothers Hill. Guests enjoy elevated dining on the 22nd‑floor Chef’s Table, a rooftop infinity pool, wellness spa, Beach Club, and the exclusive Club Millésime lounge for personalized service and private check‑in.

The design vision is led by Brazilian architect Patricia Anastassiadis, whose storytelling approach blends heritage, artistry, and contemporary sophistication, creating spaces that feel both meaningful and deeply connected to place. Set beneath the iconic Christ the Redeemer, Sofitel Rio de Janeiro Ipanema stands as the ultimate destination for discerning travelers—where luxury meets the true soul of Rio.

Position

As our E-Commerce & Marketing Manager , you are the hotel’s digital and brand positioning architect. This role elevates the hotel’s visibility across all digital touchpoints, drives direct revenue growth, and safeguards brand integrity in alignment with Sofitel standards. As a key member of the Commercial Leadership Team, this role reports to the General Manager and combines strategic vision with analytical rigor, ensuring the hotel is positioned as a preferred destination for discerning travelers, meetings, and social events.

What You Will Do

Digital Strategy & Direct Revenue Growth

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive e‑commerce strategy to maximize direct bookings and optimize digital conversion
  • Drive performance across brand.com, OTA channels, luxury consortia platforms, and paid media
  • Oversee website content, digital platforms optimization, booking engine performance, and SEO/SEM initiatives

  • Monitor digital KPIs (conversion, traffic, pace, channel mix) and provide actionable insights

  • Protect and elevate the hotel’s luxury positioning across all digital and print platforms

  • Collaborate with global/brand teams to ensure compliance with brand standards and campaigns
  • Lead content creation including photography, video, social storytelling, and partnership activations

Social Media & Content Marketing

  • Curate a refined and aspirational social presence aligned with luxury traveler expectations
  • Develop an annual content calendar supporting key revenue periods, F&B activations, spa offerings, and seasonal experiences
  • Foster influencer, media, and strategic partnerships that enhance brand visibility

Performance Marketing & Analytics

  • Own monthly digital performance reporting and budget tracking
  • Analyze market trends, competitive positioning, and customer behavior
  • Identify new digital opportunities to enhance share of voice and market share
  • Work closely with Revenue Management to align digital strategy with pricing and demand periods

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Sales, Revenue, and Operations to support need periods, group campaigns, and F&B initiatives
  • Support hotel’s pre‑opening positioning strategies
  • Act as the hotel’s digital champion, driving innovation and best practices

Qualifications

What You Will Bring

  • 5+ years in luxury hospitality marketing, e‑commerce, or digital commerce
  • Proven track record driving direct revenue, digital campaigns, and brand.com performance
  • Experience with booking engines, OTAs, digital distribution, loyalty programs, and CRM campaigns
  • Analytical expertise in KPIs, revenue performance, and campaign ROI
  • Luxury brand sensibility with strategic commercial acumen
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese; French is a plus
  • Multi‑property or pre‑opening experience is advantageous

Additional Information

How You Will Shine

  • Demonstrate humble excellence through a distinguished presence, refined savoir‑faire, and meticulous attention to detail (Cousu Main)
  • Be a passionate team player — warm, sociable, and genuinely caring toward others

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
When defining the purpose of a job it is helpful to consider questions like:

  • In what way does it contribute to the value of company?
  • What part of the organisation’s or team’s total purpose is accomplished by people in this job?
  • What is the unique contribution of this job that distinguishes it from other jobs?

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS

As a Senior Network Engineer, you will be a valuable team member on our Enterprise Network Operations team supporting SES’s Corporate and Commercial Aviation Networks and Security infrastructure. This individual will be part of a team responsible for the implementation and troubleshooting of SES’s growing network and datacenter presence around the world. You will lead and assist with various projects that will challenge your skills with routing, switching, security, VoIP, and multi-media services including inflight entertainment. This position will work with and manage vendor relations and could have a voice in the purchase/quote process, as our business continues to expand. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, possesses deep troubleshooting skills, and understands the delicate balance between network uptime and security compliance.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve network issues involving Intelsat switches, routers, circuits, etc.
  • Troubleshoot issues with our Palo Alto and Juniper firewall platform as well as implement policy rule changes to facilitate new services and connectivity.
  • Document changes to all SES infrastructure to include Visio diagrams, spreadsheets, and cloud-based tracking and documentation software.
  • Collaborate with Network Engineering on the implementation, buildout, decommissioning, and refresh of SES teleports, datacenters, and sales offices.
  • Coordinate with system design and network operations for existing data expansion, consolidation, and relocation.
  • Manage vendor relationships to get their equipment specs, list prices and other vendor information.
  • Collaborate with Network Engineering on the development of floor plan layouts for datacenters and corporate offices.
  • Develop equipment purchase orders, track orders, and arrange implementation with remote hands if not traveling for datacenter and corporate office related equipment.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5-7 years’ hands‑on experience working in large complex network / datacenter environments specifically managing Cisco, Palo Alto, Juniper and F5 hardware.
  • Strong command of Cisco IOS, IOS‑XE, and NX‑OS, PAN‑OS, JUNOS, F5 and Linux command‑line interfaces.
  • Advanced knowledge of Switching technologies to include, Spanning Tree (RPVST+, MST), LACP, VLANs, and Trunking.
  • Proficient with routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, RIPv2, MPLS, HSRP, VRRP, GLBP, SD‑WAN)
  • Working knowledge of F5 load balancing to include monitoring and troubleshooting load balancing VIPs, pools, and health monitors to minimize downtime and ensure seamless failover across multi‑data center environments
  • Working knowledge of Linux Operating system to include monitoring, automation of operational tasks, and troubleshooting Linux parameters, file systems, and network stacks to maximize performance for high‑throughput applications.
  • Working knowledge with dual homing service providers and ISP redundancy
  • Extensive experience working with Cisco hardware including switches, routers, ASRs, ASA, FWSM, IPS, load balancers, Nexus
  • Hands‑on troubleshooting skills to include Wireshark packet capture debugging and analysis.
  • In depth knowledge of security protocols, TACACS, RADIUS, different flavors of VPN and remote access.
  • Experience with Telco services, T1, DS3, SONET, OC3 – 192.
  • Datacenter design, redundancy and failover experience a plus
  • Racking various types of networks and server equipment.
  • Documentation skills for datacenter, corporate office, and remote sales offices.
  • Advanced troubleshooting skills of datacenter and office network environments.

OTHER KEY REQUIREMENTS / COMMENTS

  • PCNSA (Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Administrator)

description:

Por que trabalhar conosco?

Porque somos a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão em prática fazendo a diferença nos 178 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 26 milhões de pessoas. Somos inspirados a transformar o futuro e melhorar a forma que as pessoas vivem. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos a nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de dezenas de cidades, levando saúde, dignidade e bem-estar.

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizará o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

A partir de 2020 passou por uma revisão e seu objetivo foi reconfigurado: espelhar a população negra em todos os níveis hierárquicos.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

  • Apoiar nos projetos de abastecimento de água e transporte de esgoto;
  • Identificar gargalos e propor soluções de melhorias de maneira rápida e eficiente;
  • Manter interface do COI com a unidade de negócio e com os outros setores (apoio com modelagem, TI, perdas, comunicação, despacho e serviços);
  • Apoiar a unidade de negócio nos eventos, seja na busca pela causa raiz ou na organização do evento;
  • Garantir que o time interno entenda e conheça o abastecimento de cada unidade de negócio.
  • Ensino superior completo Engenharia ou áreas afins;

quer fazer parte de um time apaixonado por moda e por gente? vem pra FARM!

  • colaborar para que a loja permaneça atrativa, organizada e encantadora para os clientes.
  • ser responsável pelas atividades administrativas da loja, incluindo:
  • gestão das solicitações de insumos;
  • gerenciamento de contas a pagar;
  • operação de processos de omnichannel;
  • participação em inventários;
  • garantia de pleno funcionamento de processos e equipamentos da loja.
  • trabalhar bem em equipe, com espírito colaborativo e inclusivo;
  • facilidade de comunicação, com gentileza na oratória e “escutatória”;
  • interesse por moda, tendências, boas conversas e paixão pelo que faz;
  • ser uma pessoa dinâmica, flexível, ágil de se adaptar e organizada;
  • ter visão estratégica para entregar resultados e soluções de problemas;
  • domínio de ferramentas digitais e redes sociais;
  • conhecimento básico do pacote office;
  • desejável experiência anterior na função e no sistema Linx;
  • ensino médio completo;
  • flexibilidade de horário.

quem faz parte do time comercial FARM tem direito à:

  • wellz: plataforma de saúde mental e bem estar;
  • assistência médica e odontológica, disponível mediante taxa de adesão e coparticipação de acordo com o uso;
  • política parental estendida: 180 dias para mães, 20 dias para pais;
  • day off, para curtir o seu aniversário;
  • e a melhor parte: descontos em roupas e acessórios da FARM e demais marcas do grupo AZZAS.

Nasceu no Rio, cresceu no Brasil e se espalhou pelo mundo

a nossa história começou há 27 anos, em um pequeno estande na Babilônia Feira Hype, onde dois amigos, Kátia Barros e Marcelo Bastos, compartilhavam suas criações e espalhavam boas energias. o que nasceu no coração do Rio logo conquistou a cena local, ganhou o Brasil e se transformou no que somos hoje.

em 2019, cruzamos fronteiras e levamos o estilo de vida da FARM Rio para o mundo. de Nova York a Los Angeles, de Paris a Londres, nossas cores, estampas e essência seguem inspirando pessoas pelos quatro cantos do planeta. e seguimos sonhando, criando e levando o Brasil no coração para cada lugar que nos recebe.

O Técnico de Enfermagem exerce atividades relacionadas aos cuidados de enfermagem de média e pequena complexidade, auxiliando a equipe de saúde na execução dos trabalhos em nível hospitalar, com foco no cumprimento da prescrição de enfermagem.

Realizar procedimentos gerais e específicos de enfermagem, tais como: prestar assistência aos pacientes através de cuidados de higienização, auxílio a alimentação, verificação de glicemia capilar, terapias de suporte respiratório (micro e macro nebulização), aspiração de vias aéreas, manipulação de sondas e drenos, efetuando a limpeza e a desinfecção de materiais utilizados pelos pacientes, preparando corpo pós-morte, prestando assistência contínua aos pacientes em cuidados no fim da vida e sedação controlada, administrando medicamento via oral, endovenoso, intramuscular e subcutâneo, observando horários e posologia conforme a prescrição médica, a fim de obter o equilíbrio clínico dos pacientes;

Receber e passar plantão junto à equipe de enfermagem, tomando e/ou dando ciência de todas as anormalidades e eventuais ocorrências no período, com objetivo de garantir a comunicação efetiva para continuidade do cuidado;

Coletar materiais para análise laboratorial, identificando-os e encaminhando-os aos laboratórios específicos, a fim de que sejam efetuadas as devidas análises;

Controlar e/ou efetuar desinfecção de materiais utilizados nos procedimentos através de técnicas apropriadas preconizadas pela Comissão de Controle de Infecção Hospitalar – CCIH, registrando e informando dados, a fim de minimizar os riscos de transmissão de infecção;

Participar de treinamento em serviço, a fim de garantir a atualização científica na área, garantindo a qualidade da assistência de enfermagem e a segurança do paciente.

Realizar limpeza de utensílios de banho (comadres, patinhos, balde, jarra, bacias), e de terapia respiratória que serão enviados para reprocessamento, através de técnicas apropriadas preconizadas pela Comissão de Controle de Infecção Hospitalar – CCIH, registrando e informando dados, a fim de minimizar os riscos de transmissão de infecção.

Formação Técnica em Enfermagem;

Desejável experiência na função.

Administração de medicamentos;

Saúde do Idoso.

Por este motivo, o Hospital Placi chegou para ocupar esse espaço no tratamento pós agudo, oferecendo um atendimento humanizado e acolhedor com uma proposta do cuidado individualizado para:

title: Fonoaudiólogo(a)
description:
MISSÃO

Diagnosticar, planejar, propor e executar intervenções voltadas para o desenvolvimento de habilidades de linguagem e comunicação em crianças e adolescentes com Transtorno do Espectro Autista (TEA), atuando em equipe interdisciplinar e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento e o bem‑estar dos aprendizes neurodiversos.

ATIVIDADES

Acolhida/Contato Inicial com o Aprendiz, Família, Escola e Equipe Multidisciplinar

  • Realizar acolhimento inicial das famílias e dos clientes, escutando e legitimando queixas e expectativas para alinhamento com a intervenção proposta.
  • Coletar e selecionar informações do histórico do indivíduo e da família, bem como dados de equipes multidisciplinares e escolas.
  • Esclarecer possíveis dúvidas que a família, escola ou equipe interdisciplinar possam ter sobre nosso trabalho.

Avaliação e Desenvolvimento do Plano Terapêutico

  • Estabelecer vínculo com o cliente antes de iniciar o processo de avaliação, a fim de garantir maior fidedignidade nas análises realizadas.
  • Planejar e conduzir avaliações fonoaudiológicas utilizando protocolos específicos da área, bem como participar de avaliações interdisciplinares, sob supervisão técnica, assegurando a integração e a coerência das informações coletadas.
  • Redigir relatórios de avaliação e elaborar planos terapêuticos individualizados junto com a equipe interdisciplinar.
  • Definir carga horária e local de atendimento do cliente, em conjunto com a equipe interdisciplinar.

Intervenção

  • Implementar o plano terapêutico individualizado, realizando a seleção, indicação e aplicação de métodos, técnicas e procedimentos terapêuticos adequados para crianças e adolescentes com TEA, com suporte da supervisão técnica.
  • Aplicar técnicas baseadas em evidências, com ênfase nos métodos voltados para transtornos motores da fala e para comunicação aumentativa e alternativa.
  • Adaptar e modificar as intervenções conforme necessário, com base no progresso do aprendiz.
  • Registrar e monitorar o progresso do aprendiz, mantendo registros organizados e atualizados.

Coordenação, Monitoramento e Trabalho em Equipe

  • Participar ativamente de reuniões e discussões com a equipe interdisciplinar, incluindo terapeutas ABA, coordenadores e supervisores.
  • Respeitar e colaborar com profissionais de outras áreas, reconhecendo a supervisão do caso pelo supervisor ABA.
  • Receber supervisão da fonoaudióloga sênior da clínica, implementando feedbacks para aprimorar a prática clínica.
  • Demonstrar humildade para reconhecer erros e disposição para aprender e crescer profissionalmente.
  • Orientar e fornecer suporte às famílias, cuidadores e, quando apropriado, à equipe escolar.

ESCOLARIDADE/FORMAÇÃO

  • Ensino superior completo em Fonoaudiologia, com registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Fonoaudiologia (CRFa).
  • Formação em intervenção motora da fala (PROMPT, DTTC, REST) e CAA (desejável).
  • Conhecimento em Análise do Comportamento Aplicada (ABA) e TEA.
  • Cursos complementares em Motricidade Orofacial e TEA (diferencial).

EXPERIÊNCIA PROFISSIONAL

  • Experiência anterior de 6 meses na área.

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

You’ll enter our engineering interview process as part of a pooled hiring model. We believe in hiring for Carta first, focusing on your core strengths and technical craft rather than a specific team’s immediate gap.

Staff Engineers at Carta are technical anchors for our business. You don’t just own features, you take long‑term accountability for the technical health and strategic direction of different domains. As you move through our process, we’ll transition from the general pool to a team‑matching phase. Our goal is to match your unique technical strengths, and personal career interests with our most impactful, strategic challenges.

Strategic areas you may influence

  • Platform Data Ecosystem: Shaping how data flows across our entire suite of products to ensure a “single source of truth” for private market data.
  • Financial Systems Architecture: Designing resilient, scalable solutions for management fee accounting and multi‑currency transactions.
  • Engineering Excellence: Defining company‑wide standards that reduce operational load and improve developer velocity across dozens of teams.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As a Staff Engineer, you are responsible for the long‑term technical health and success of your business unit. You’ll work to:

  • Navigate Ambiguity: Tackle the most complex and poorly defined problems at Carta, breaking them down into navigable paths for the rest of the organization.
  • Champion Systemic Improvement: Identify and eliminate failure patterns across multiple systems, driving architectural changes that improve scalability and reliability.
  • Bridge Technical Gaps: Use your deep understanding of cross‑functional domains to align multiple teams on major technical decisions.
  • Define the AI Frontier: Lead the charge in transforming how we build by defining the context and building the rails that allow every person at Carta to leverage AI tools safely and effectively. You’ll help move the organization toward a future where AI amplifies our collective engineering impact.
  • Uphold Engineering Standards: Set the vision for operational excellence and mentor senior engineers to raise the collective craft of the organization.

About You

  • The Tech Stack: You are an expert in building distributed systems. While our primary stack is Python/Django, React, and Postgres, you should be comfortable guiding technical direction across JVM languages, gRPC, and cloud‑native infrastructure (AWS).
  • Leadership: You lead through influence rather than authority, acting as a role model for constructive communication and technical discipline.
  • Vision: You don't just solve the problem in front of you; you anticipate future roadblocks and build systems that support long‑term business growth.
  • Experience: We recommend 10+ years of professional software engineering experience with a track record of high‑level technical leadership.

Disclosures

title: Manager, Risk Management, Intelligence & C4 (RiC4)
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Safety & Security

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Manager, Risk Management, Intelligence & C4 (RiC4) is responsible for leading the structured identification, assessment, monitoring and mitigation of safety and security risks for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The role establishes and manages the tournament-wide risk management framework, supports intelligence coordination and contributes to the development and implementation of the C4 (Command, Control, Communications and Computers) governance structure. The position ensures that risk-informed decision-making underpins all safety and security planning and operational activities across official tournament sites.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement a formal risk and threat identification, assessment and prioritisation process for all official tournament sites and activities
  • Develop, maintain and continuously update the tournament-wide security risk register, ensuring risks are tracked, assessed and mitigated throughout all phases of the event
  • Conduct risk assessment analyses for host cities, stadiums, non-competition sites as well as other specific ancillary events, matches, sites or activities, and develop corresponding risk treatment action plans
  • Coordinate threat, intelligence and situational awareness inputs from domestic and international partners, ensuring structured analysis and dissemination
  • Continuously gather and analyse intelligence relevant to tournament operations and provide structured strategic and operational briefings to senior management and relevant functional areas
  • Support the design, implementation and continuous improvement of the C4 (Command, Control, Communications & Coordination) systems, ensuring alignment with the overall FWWC operational governance framework
  • Enable effective information flow to leadership and operational teams, including leading the daily reporting rhythms and information cycles as defined in the C4i concept
  • Develop standard operating protocols for escalating, responding to and monitoring operational risks
  • Assist in determining appropriate security assets and protective measures required to safeguard official sites and assets
  • Establish and maintain strong working relationships with domestic and, where required, international intelligence agencies and/or with the relevant FA Manager (Public Security) to support integrated security planning
  • Support and encourage the establishment of a Police Cooperation Centre (or equivalent mechanism) to enhance intelligence and information sharing among stakeholders
  • Monitor compliance with statutory, regulatory and organisational instruments relevant to risk management and security operations
  • Support and advise on background check protocols and related risk considerations in coordination with the Accreditation & Access functions

Your Profile

Education

  • University degree in security management, risk management, criminology, intelligence studies, public safety or a related field

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in risk management, intelligence coordination or security analysis, preferably within major events, public safety agencies or multi‑agency environments
  • Proven experience in developing and managing risk registers and structured risk assessment frameworks
  • Experience working with law enforcement, intelligence services or governmental security bodies in Brazil
  • Familiarity with command and control structures and operational coordination models

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to synthesize complex information into actionable insights
  • High attention to detail and structured documentation capability
  • Ability to exercise discretion and handle sensitive information with integrity
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the preparation of strategic briefings
  • Ability to work collaboratively across multiple functional areas and external partners
  • Advanced IT proficiency including MS Office suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in Portuguese

Certifications & Requirements

  • Willingness to travel nationally and work extended hours during tournament periods
  • Fluency in Portuguese (spoken and written) is essential, English desirable
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Host City Manager - Brasília will be responsible for the institutional management of FIFA's relationship with the state and municipal governments of the respective Host City of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™.

Acting as the main local liaison, this professional will ensure the monitoring and coordination of government commitments under their responsibility, ensuring continuous alignment with FIFA's strategy and guidelines.

The position is preferably based in the Host City itself, ensuring local presence, institutional proximity, and direct monitoring of agendas.

The Manager will report directly to the Head of Government Relations and Host Cities.

The tournament will be staged across 8 stadiums in Brazil, and we’re recruiting the Host City Manager for Brasília.

Please apply only if you currently live in Brasília or can relocate there independently.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Institutional Relations with State and Municipal Governments
    • Act as FIFA's main institutional representative to the State Government and City Hall of the Host City under your responsibility.
    • Maintain ongoing relationships with state and municipal secretariats, autonomous agencies, public companies, and other relevant local bodies.
    • Ensure that local authorities are aligned with the commitments made in the Host City Agreement and other instruments signed with FIFA.
  2. Monitoring of Government Deliverables
    • Monitor and report on the status of state and municipal government obligations related to the tournament.
    • Identify risks, bottlenecks, and schedule deviations, proposing solutions and making the necessary adjustments.

    • Act as a link between the Host City and FIFA's functional areas (Security, Transportation, Operations, Sustainability, Communications, among others).

    • Support the organization of technical visits, workshops, meetings, and official FIFA agendas in the Host City.
  4. Planning, Reporting, and Governance
    • Prepare periodic reports on institutional relations and the status of the Host City's commitments.
    • Update reports, schedules, and monitoring tools defined by the Government Relations area.

  • Organization and method: Ability to structure processes, prioritize demands, and perform tasks efficiently.

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Manager, Risk Management, Intelligence & C4 (RiC4) is responsible for leading the structured identification, assessment, monitoring and mitigation of safety and security risks for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The role establishes and manages the tournament-wide risk management framework, supports intelligence coordination and contributes to the development and implementation of the C4 (Command, Control, Communications and Computers) governance structure. The position ensures that risk-informed decision-making underpins all safety and security planning and operational activities across official tournament sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and implement a formal risk and threat identification, assessment and prioritisation process for all official tournament sites and activities
  • Develop, maintain and continuously update the tournament-wide security risk register, ensuring risks are tracked, assessed and mitigated throughout all phases of the event
  • Conduct risk assessment analyses for host cities, stadiums, non-competition sites as well as other specific ancillary events, matches, sites or activities, and develop corresponding risk treatment action plans
  • Coordinate threat, intelligence and situational awareness inputs from domestic and international partners, ensuring structured analysis and dissemination
  • Continuously gather and analyse intelligence relevant to tournament operations and provide structured strategic and operational briefings to senior management and relevant functional areas
  • Support the design, implementation and continuous improvement of the C4 (Command, Control, Communications & Coordination) systems, ensuring alignment with the overall FWWC operational governance framework
  • Enable effective information flow to leadership and operational teams, including leading the daily reporting rhythms and information cycles as defined in the C4i concept
  • Develop standard operating protocols for escalating, responding to and monitoring operational risks
  • Assist in determining appropriate security assets and protective measures required to safeguard official sites and assets
  • Establish and maintain strong working relationships with domestic and, where required, international intelligence agencies and/or with the relevant FA Manager (Public Security) to support integrated security planning
  • Support and encourage the establishment of a Police Cooperation Centre (or equivalent mechanism) to enhance intelligence and information sharing among stakeholders
  • Monitor compliance with statutory, regulatory and organisational instruments relevant to risk management and security operations
  • Support and advise on background check protocols and related risk considerations in coordination with the Accreditation & Access functions

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • University degree in security management, risk management, criminology, intelligence studies, public safety or a related field

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in risk management, intelligence coordination or security analysis, preferably within major events, public safety agencies or multi‑agency environments
  • Proven experience in developing and managing risk registers and structured risk assessment frameworks
  • Experience working with law enforcement, intelligence services or governmental security bodies in Brazil
  • Familiarity with command and control structures and operational coordination models

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to synthesise complex information into actionable insights
  • High attention to detail and structured documentation capability
  • Ability to exercise discretion and handle sensitive information with integrity
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the preparation of strategic briefings
  • Ability to work collaboratively across multiple functional areas and external partners
  • Advanced IT proficiency including MS Office suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in Portuguese

Certifications & Requirements

  • Willingness to travel nationally and work extended hours during tournament periods
  • Fluency in Portuguese (spoken and written) is essential, English desirable
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

    • Gestão e acompanhamento de CAPEX;
  • Conhecimentos básicos sobre empreendimentos de transmissão de energia (subestações e linhas de transmissão);
  • Conhecimento dos processos de gestão contratual, desde as fases que antecedem, até o encerramento;
  • Conhecimento do Manual de Controle Patrimonial do Setor Elétrico - MCPSE da ANEEL;
  • Conhecimento dos processos corporativos de planejamento e orçamento;
  • Conhecimento prático dos pacotes SAP de gestão de projetos, controle orçamentário, e gestão financeira;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de apoio à gestão, incluindo:
    • Excel em nível avançado;
    • Disponibilidade para residir no Rio de Janeiro/RJ , São Paulo/SP ou Brasília/DF.

  • Domínio do Microsoft Project e Conhecimento avançado do pacote Office;
  • Domínio em linguagem de programação como Pyton e similares;

  • Conhecimento do cadastramento, atualização e baixas de obras no sistema Sintegra do ONS;
  • Desejável Certificações: PMP (Project Management Professional) do PMI (Project Management Institute) ou IPMA (International Project Management Association);

Na AXIA Energia, o bem-estar e a qualidade de vida das nossas pessoas impulsionam a energia que nos move. description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Team You’ll Work With

You’ll enter our engineering interview process as part of a pooled hiring model. We believe in hiring for Carta first, focusing on your core strengths and technical craft rather than a specific team’s immediate gap.

Staff Engineers at Carta are technical anchors for our business. You don’t just own features, you take long‑term accountability for the technical health and strategic direction of different domains. As you move through our process, we’ll transition from the general pool to a team‑matching phase. Our goal is to match your unique technical strengths, and personal career interests with our most impactful, strategic challenges.

Strategic areas you may influence

  • Platform Data Ecosystem: Shaping how data flows across our entire suite of products to ensure a "single source of truth" for private market data.
  • Financial Systems Architecture: Designing resilient, scalable solutions for management fee accounting and multi‑currency transactions.
  • Engineering Excellence: Defining company‑wide standards that reduce operational load and improve developer velocity across dozens of teams.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As a Staff Engineer, you are responsible for the long‑term technical health and success of your business unit. You’ll work to:

  • Navigate Ambiguity: Tackle the most complex and poorly defined problems at Carta, breaking them down into navigable paths for the rest of the organization.
  • Champion Systemic Improvement: Identify and eliminate failure patterns across multiple systems, driving architectural changes that improve scalability and reliability.
  • Bridge Technical Gaps: Use your deep understanding of cross‑functional domains to align multiple teams on major technical decisions.
  • Define the AI Frontier: Lead the charge in transforming how we build by defining the context and building the rails that allow every person at Carta to leverage AI tools safely and effectively. You’ll help move the organization toward a future where AI amplifies our collective engineering impact.
  • Uphold Engineering Standards: Set the vision for operational excellence and mentor senior engineers to raise the collective craft of the organization.

About You

  • The Tech Stack: You are an expert in building distributed systems. While our primary stack is Python/Django, React, and Postgres, you should be comfortable guiding technical direction across JVM languages, gRPC, and cloud‑native infrastructure (AWS).
  • Leadership: You lead through influence rather than authority, acting as a role model for constructive communication and technical discipline.
  • Vision: You don't just solve the problem in front of you; you anticipate future roadblocks and build systems that support long‑term business growth.
  • Experience: We recommend 10+ years of professional software engineering experience with a track record of high‑level technical leadership.

Disclosures
