title: Senior Operations Manager
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Senior People Operations Officer serves as the College’s principal operational administrator for all HR-, payroll-, and hiring-related transactions. This role ensures the accuracy, compliance, and timely processing of personnel actions for faculty, staff, adjuncts, student employees, wage workers, and stipend-supported personnel. The incumbent functions as the College’s primary point of coordination between CEA leadership, HR, Payroll, the Office of the Provost, and departmental administrators. This is not an HR strategic role; instead, it is a senior-level operational and transactional position responsible for end‑to‑end workflow execution, Workday processing, onboarding, offboarding, and compliance.

Supervisory Authority

Responsible for supervising the Budget Coordinator, Administrative III. Formally plans, assigns, directs, and evaluates work performed. Makes merit and promotion recommendations to the Dean and ensures professional development alignment with institutional expectations.

Nature And Scope

The Senior People Operations Officer interacts daily with academic departments, program directors, faculty, HR Business Partners, the Budget Office, Payroll, and the Office of the Provost. The incumbent must exercise a high degree of accuracy and judgment in handling sensitive personnel information, navigating complex approval processes, and ensuring compliance with University policy, hiring standards, and audit expectations.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Serve as the College’s senior Workday transaction specialist for all hires, job changes, faculty terminations, PAPs, compensation changes, funding changes, and academic appointments.
  • Coordinate all job posting requests with HR Recruiting and ensure funding alignment prior to submission.
  • Draft and monitor term sheets, offer letters (where applicable), hiring packets, and background check requirements.
  • Manage onboarding workflows including I‑9, tax documentation, direct deposit, employee access, and new employee orientation tracking.
  • Initiate and track offboarding workflows for employees, adjunct faculty, and student workers.
  • Ensure accurate student hiring through FRFs, HAFs, wage-hire classifications, and Workday setup.
  • Maintain weekly hiring and transaction status reports for CEA leadership.
  • Conduct monthly HR and payroll compliance audits including cost allocations, active/inactive positions, and pending transactions.
  • Provide training and guidance to department administrators, chairs, and coordinators on Workday processes and personnel workflows.
  • Maintain and update standard operating procedures (SOPs) for hiring, onboarding, terminations, PAPs, and Workday routing.
  • Liaise with HR, Payroll, and the Office of the Provost to resolve transactional issues and ensure timely processing.
  • Serve as subject‑matter expert for Workday HR and Workday Finance functionality relevant to personnel transactions.
  • Provide people‑data inputs to the Assistant Dean for reporting and planning (not financial analysis).
  • Manage confidential personnel information in accordance with University policies.

Core Competencies

  • Demonstrated ability to provide executive-level financial and operational guidance in a complex academic environment.
  • Deep knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, accounting controls, and resource stewardship.
  • Ability to interpret policy, influence adoption, and lead change with diplomacy and clarity in evolving systems.
  • Ability to supervise, develop, mentor, and evaluate staff performance and ensure accountability.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to present complex financial and operational issues clearly.
  • Skilled in Workday Financials, procurement systems, and advanced spreadsheet and reporting tools.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Business Administration, or related field (required)
  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience working in higher‑education operations.
  • Workday HR and Workday Finance familiarity.
  • Experience working with academic departments.
  • Administrative operations experience
  • Proficiency in Workday HR required.
  • Proficiency in Workday Finance preferred.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and shared workflow systems.
  • Ability to run reports, analyze personnel data, and maintain accurate records.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$20,000-$30,000

title: Sr. Product Manager, Growth (NGL) (Remote)
description:
Who We Are

Mode Mobile builds apps that reward users for engaging with content, entertainment, games, and communities they love. Our portfolio includes category-defining products with millions of users globally, scaling rapidly through organic growth and strategic acquisitions.

You will be joining NGL ("Not Gonna Lie") , one of the most viral social apps in recent years, with 144M+ monthly users across web and mobile. NGL provides a safe, curious, and authentic space for people to connect through anonymous messaging and self-expression.

Now part of Mode Mobile's portfolio, NGL is entering its next phase of explosive growth, including expanded monetization, creative experimentation, and scaled user acquisition initiatives.

The Mission

Own and scale NGL's revenue, funnels, and lifecycle growth by turning traffic into durable, monetizable user behavior. You will run growth as a system…from acquisition through retention…while protecting the viral mechanics that make NGL work.

This role is measured in metrics shipped , not features shipped.

Our Team and Culture Drive Our Success

Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, and curiosity, with a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster a culture of open communication and transparency. We are driven and hard‑working but also committed to having fun along the way. We allow OKRs to guide us, assume positive intent, sometimes agree to disagree and commit, honor our commitments, seek to accomplish more with less, and encourage everyone to speak up as our team owns our company's success.

You can read more about our team and how we work here.

The Role

This role reports directly to the General Manager – NGL and operates as the single‑threaded owner of growth and monetization for the product. You will work cross‑functionally with Monetization, Paid UA, Engineering, Design, and Data , and you will own feature rollout end‑to‑end in partnership with Engineering.

What You’ll Do

  • Monetization Systems
    • You own all product‑led revenue systems:
      • Subscription pricing, tiers, and trials
      • Optimize onboarding and paywall timing by traffic source
      • One‑time purchases (reveals, hints, boosts)
      • Paywall timing, copy, UX, and placement
      • Revenue per active user (ARPDAU / ARPU)
      • Monetization performance by cohort (influencer, paid UA, organic)
      • Extensive collaboration with Monetization Team by translating revenue strategy into shipped product features
    • You are accountable for revenue lift without growth decay.
  • Organic Funnels, Influencer & Creator Funnels
    • NGL is creator‑driven. You own:
      • Influencer onboarding flows
      • Creator‑specific product surfaces and incentives
      • Conversion paths from influencer posts → installs → paid actions
      • Monetization differences by creator tier and audience quality
      • Feedback loops that increase creator posting frequency and retention
    • Partnerships source creators. Product owns the funnel.
  • Funnel Ownership (End‑to‑End)
    • You own the full lifecycle:
      • Entry (Snap, IG, TikTok, deep links)
      • First‑session experience and activation
      • Message reveal mechanics and engagement triggers
      • Re‑engagement loops (notifications, prompts, scarcity)
      • Conversion to paid
      • Design funnels that improve LTV and payback
      • Retention, churn reduction, and win‑back flows
    • You are expected to know where every drop‑off lives.
  • Experimentation & Growth Velocity
    • You will:
      • Maintain a prioritized growth experiment backlog
      • Run continuous A/B tests across onboarding, pricing, and UX
      • Test influencer‑specific monetization strategies
      • Kill underperforming ideas quickly
      • Scale winners aggressively
      • K‑Factor Optimization
    • Speed and learning rate matter more than perfection.
  • Feature Ownership & Rollout (Engineering)
    • You own feature execution end‑to‑end:
      • Write clear PRDs tied to growth and revenue outcomes
      • Prioritize engineering work based on expected impact
      • Partner with engineering to ship experiments quickly
      • Own rollout plans, gating, and ramp strategies
      • Monitor post‑launch performance and iterate fast
    • You ship, measure, and refine. No throw‑it‑over‑the‑wall handoffs.
  • Reporting, Dashboards & GM Updates
    • You will:
      • Build and maintain clear growth dashboards
      • Report weekly to the NGL GM on:
        • Revenue performance
        • Funnel metrics
        • Experiment results
        • Key risks and opportunities
        • Provide data‑backed recommendations for roadmap and spend decisions
      • The GM should never be surprised by the numbers

Success in This Role Means

  • You are directly accountable for:
    • Paid conversion rate
    • ARPU / LTV
    • D7 / D30 retention
    • Revenue by acquisition source
    • LTV / CAC and payback period
    • Experiment velocity

What You Bring to the Team

  • 5–8+ years of experience in Growth Product, Monetization, or Lifecycle Product roles within consumer mobile apps, with clear ownership of revenue and growth outcomes
  • Direct ownership of core metrics such as ARPDAU, ARPU, LTV, conversion rate, retention, and payback
  • Experience scaling subscription and hybrid monetization models, including subscriptions and one‑time purchases
  • Experience owning pricing strategy, paywalls, onboarding optimization, and revenue performance by cohort
  • Strong data fluency, including cohort analysis, funnel diagnostics, and payback modeling
  • Proven track record running high‑velocity A/B testing and maintaining a structured experimentation backlog
  • Demonstrated success improving acquisition, activation, monetization, and retention through measurable experimentation
  • Experience partnering closely with Engineering to ship growth and monetization features end‑to‑end
  • Experience working cross‑functionally with UA, Monetization, Design, and Data teams
  • Comfort operating as the accountable owner of revenue impact
  • A systems mindset that prioritizes measurable outcomes over feature output
  • Ability to move quickly, make decisions with imperfect information, and balance aggressive growth optimization with protecting product integrity and viral mechanics
  • Experience in creator‑driven or social products preferred
  • Experience optimizing K‑Factor and viral loops preferred
  • Experience working with Snap, Instagram, or TikTok acquisition funnels preferred
  • Alignment with our core values:
    • Accountable: You take ownership of your responsibilities, demonstrating trustworthiness and self‑discipline. You are consistent in your work, transparent in your actions, and communicate effectively. You follow through on commitments and strive for continuous improvement.
    • Action‑driven: Identify what is most important, agree on scope, execute in a timely manner, and drive the greatest impact. You take initiative, roll up your sleeves, and get things done.
    • Caring: You genuinely care about yourself and others, our business and craft, our mission and vision, and are passionate in heart and mind. You understand the importance of our team and strive to create a positive, supportive work environment.
    • Curious: You focus on the 'why,' learn and expand your knowledge, explore new ideas, and generally make things better. You're a lifelong learner with a thirst for knowledge and a constant desire to improve.
    • Thorough: Your work is thoughtful, impactful, timely, accurate, and complete. You pay attention to detail, are meticulous, and ensure quality work and compliance.

Why Join Mode Mobile

  • Be part of a company where the culture is the magic . Our team consistently says the best part of Mode is the people – collaborative, humble, hungry, and genuinely invested in each other's success.
  • Make an impact on millions of users across a global social platform with massive scale and cultural relevance.
  • Work with a global, top‑tier engineering team that cares deeply about craftsmanship, velocity, and helping each other win.
  • Shape the next stage of a high‑growth social platform , entering an exciting next phase of growth, scale, and innovation.
  • Join a mission‑driven culture where ownership is real, ideas travel fast, and your work has a visible impact.
  • Grow inside a fast‑growing, post‑acquisition business backed by strong leadership and investment in monetization, UA, and product innovation.
  • Work fully remote with a globally distributed team that values autonomy, trust, and transparent collaboration.

We Believe in the Following Workplace Norms

  • Allow OKRs to Guide Us
  • Assume Positive Intent
  • Agree to Disagree & Commit
  • Set New Precedents
  • Accomplish More with Less
  • Hold Yourself & Others to High Standards
  • Speak Up
  • Be Resourceful
  • Follow the 80/20 Rule

What We Are Offering

  • We are a 100% remote‑first, global company.
  • A competitive compensation package.
  • We offer generous perks & benefits to team members.
  • Participation in the Company's equity plan (for full‑time team members).
  • We provide individual bonuses in accordance with our Company Bonus Program.
  • Work with energetic, passionate, and results‑driven people.
  • Celebrate team members' personal and work milestones.
  • Remote social activities, including virtual coffee buddies.
  • Bonusly – We use Bonusly as a way to recognize and reward team members for their hard work and commitment.
  • Weekly Wednesday Get Stuff Done Days (No Meetings).
  • Open PTO, generous Company Holidays, and Wellness Days (for full‑time team members).

If we just described you and your perfect role, we'd love to talk with you. We have a lot to accomplish this year and look forward to making headway and creating success together!

title: Investment Director Climate Investor 2
description:
Climate Fund Managers B.V. (CFM) is a leading blended finance fund manager dedicated to securing a sustainable future by investing across global emerging markets. CFM has a long-term vision to structure cutting edge financing facilities around thematic areas of climate change mitigation and adaptation, including renewable energy, water and oceans, sustainable land use, and sustainable cities. CFM is established as a joint venture between the Dutch development bank FMO and Sanlam InfraWorks – part of the Sanlam Group of South Africa with offices in The Hague, Cape Town, Windhoek, Singapore and Bogota.

CFM is subject to supervision by the Dutch Authority for the Financial Markets (Autoriteit Financiële Markten or “AFM”) and/or the Dutch Central Bank (De Nederlandsche Bank N.V. or “DNB”) and is authorised to act as investment manager (beheerder ).

Job Purpose

We are seeking an Investment Director to strengthen our Investments and Asset Management team. This role will report to the Regional Head of Latin America and will be ideally based in Brazil (Sao Paulo (preferred) or Rio de Janeiro). The Investment Director will interface CFM divisions and offices.

As a leader in the sustainable finance sector and a pioneer in the renewable energy, water sanitation, oceans infrastructure and green hydrogen sectors, CFM is committed to driving positive environmental impact through strategic investments in climate-related projects. The Investment Director will play a pivotal role in originating and executing on our investment strategies, managing a portfolio of water sanitation, waste valorisation opportunities and oceans infrastructure assets, contributing to the transformation of the LatAm economy and the transition to a more sustainable future.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Management and execution of CI-2 / Climate Investor Two Fund Managers Investment and Fundraising Strategy: Originate investment opportunities that align with the fund’s climate objectives, with a particular emphasis on all themes relevant in the Brazilian market that are in alignment with the CI2 mandate primarily namely water sanitation, waste transformation and oceans infrastructure projects in LatAm, taking into consideration ESG factors and the potential for positive environmental impact.
  • Portfolio Management: Invest and manage a diverse portfolio of water and sanitation and oceans infrastructure assets with a focus on strategic projects to CFM in Brazil.
  • Due Diligence: Conduct thorough due diligence on potential investment opportunities, assessing financial viability, evaluating technology readiness, environmental sustainability, market potential and key risk factors, supported by the regional Latam team.
  • Deal Structuring: Collaborate with the broader investment team to structure deals, negotiate terms, and secure financing for water, sanitation and oceans infrastructure projects in LatAm.
  • Risk Management: Monitor and mitigate risks associated with water, sanitation and oceans infrastructure investments, implementing strategies to preserve capital and maximize returns.
  • Impact Measurement: Maintain robust impact measurement frameworks to track and report on the environmental benefits of investments.
  • Stakeholder Relations: Foster strong relationships with project developers, partners, and stakeholders in the water, sanitation, and oceans infrastructure ecosystem.
  • Compliance: Ensure investments are compliant with all regulatory and ethical guidelines, staying up to date with relevant regulations and industry standards.
  • Fundraising and growth opportunities: Identify and highlight opportunities to seek new capital investors that may align with CFM’s products and growth strategies and support any such initiatives as requested.
  • Team Management: Provide management, mentorship, and guidance to junior investment professionals, promoting a collaborative and growth-oriented work environment as it may be relevant, while interacting closely with other Latam team members based in the region.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Chartered Accountant, CFA or Engineer with MBA or equivalent master’s degree.
  • A minimum of 15‑years of experience in investment banking, corporate finance with a strong track record in deal structuring and financial reporting in the Renewable Energy, Water, Waste to Energy and Oceans Infrastructure sector.
  • Strong analytical, communication and negotiation abilities.
  • English and Spanish language proficiency in addition to native Portuguese.
  • Proven ability to work across technical/financial and legal aspects of a transaction and work with various specialists internally and with government/shareholder/lender type stakeholders to provide transaction leadership.
  • Knowledge of relevant regulations and ESG Principles, compliance requirements, including but not limited to IFRS standards.
  • Ability to plan and prioritise effectively: strong project / process and team management skills.
  • Ability to apply sound business judgment and an analytical, pragmatic, and creative approach to problem solving.
  • Technically proficient (Advanced) in Excel, Word, PowerPoint essential.
  • Experience and significant proven track record of working in Brazil and other LatAm jurisdictions.
  • Work permit and residency in Brazil.

Behavioural Competencies

  • Result-oriented – Being focused on achieving objectives and results, persevering in the face of adversity.
  • Devotion to quality – Demanding a high quality on outputs and acting accordingly.
  • Planning – Systematically organizing activities and setting time frames, setting priorities.
  • Initiative – Identifying opportunities or solutions, and taking action.
  • Analysing and forming opinions – Being focused on examining matters in a systematic way.
  • Cooperation – Working with others in order to effectively contribute to a common objective.
  • Situational Awareness – Being well informed about developments in one's environment and effectively using this information for one's own organisation.
  • Performance under pressure – Maintaining an effective performance under pressure, or when faced with setbacks or disappointment.

title: Postbaccalaureate Research Fellow-2
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Function

Full‑time laboratory research position in Alzheimer’s disease and related dementia (ADRD). Key responsibilities include:

  • Conduct experiments utilizing various techniques specific to the laboratory to investigate mechanisms and treatment strategies of ADRD. Maintain detailed and accurate records of experimental procedures and results.
  • Collect, maintain, analyze, and interpret experimental data using appropriate statistical and analytical methods. Contribute to the preparation of research presentations and manuscripts.
  • Participate in lab meeting seminars, and collaborative research discussions.
  • Assist with general lab maintenance and organization, including ordering supplies and ensuring compliance with safety regulations.

Supervisory Authority

Host laboratory mentors and program leadership provide supervisory authority for HU-ERA-PREP Scholars. Fellows will report to assigned research mentors at host labs, who will provide direct oversight, mentorship and project management including ensuring accurate documentation and presentation of research activities and findings. Research supervisors will enforce compliance with institutional policies ethical guidelines and safety regulations. Regular performance evaluations will be conducted to provide constructive feedback, identify areas for improvement as well as recognize exceptional performance and contributions.

Nature And Scope

Fellows will engage in advanced research focused on mechanisms underlying Alzheimer’s disease or related dementias including preventative and treatment strategies. This position offers a unique opportunity for recent graduates to gain hands‑on research experience and contribute to high‑impact projects in a collaborative and supportive environment.

Principal Accountabilities

Postbaccalaureate Research Fellows in Alzheimer’s disease research, will play a critical role in advancing understanding of the mechanisms underlying this complex neurological disorder. In addition to basic research functions, fellows are expected to:

Mode Mobile is the creator of EarnOS, a transformational software that turns ordinary smartphones into "EarnPhones." For additional insights, check out the information about our reward‑based super app, Mode Earn App, which also powers the reward engine behind our proprietary smartphone, Mode Earn Phone.

Our Team and Culture Drive Our Success

Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, and curiosity, with a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster a culture of open communication and transparency. We are driven and hard‑working but also committed to having fun along the way. We allow OKRs to guide us, assume positive intent, sometimes agree to disagree and commit, honor our commitments, seek to accomplish more with less, and encourage everyone to speak up as our team owns our company's success.

The Role

We’re seeking a highly analytical and performance‑driven User Acquisition Manager to lead and scale paid acquisition efforts across Mode Mobile's consumer app portfolio. This role will focus on executing and optimizing campaigns across major mobile and web channels to drive efficient, profitable user growth.

The ideal candidate is a data‑driven performance marketer with strong mobile UA fundamentals, a test‑and‑learn mindset, and experience scaling spend while maintaining healthy CAC, ROAS, and LTV metrics across diverse audiences and geographies.

  • Hands‑on performance buying
  • Strong analytical rigor and experimentation discipline
  • Experience working with creative teams and external partners
  • Solid understanding of mobile growth and monetization mechanics

You’ll collaborate closely with Product, Monetization, and Creative teams, as well as Mode Mobile's centralized UA and Growth function, to deliver sustained user and revenue growth across multiple products.

Who You Are and What You'll Do

  • Plan, launch, and optimize UA campaigns across core paid channels: Meta, Google, TikTok (SRNs/SANs), Programmatic DSPs, Rewarded Ad Networks, and more
  • Responsible for daily performance tracking, pacing, and spend efficiency against KPIs (e.g., CPI, CPA, ROAS) of your campaigns
  • Manage and scale daily spend while maintaining efficient CAC, ROAS, and LTV targets
  • Run ongoing A/B and multivariate testing across creatives, formats, messaging, and funnels
  • Analyze campaign performance data to surface insights and optimization opportunities
  • Partner with creative teams to develop, test, and iterate on high‑performing ad concepts
  • Stay current on UA trends, platform changes, attribution updates, and emerging channels
  • Contribute to the evolution of Mode's growth playbook, including testing new channels, formats, and markets
  • This is an individual contributor role managing the UA efforts for the Mode Earn App and other apps, with frequent opportunities for cross‑functional collaboration, partnering with product, data analytics, and design to improve funnel performance.

What You Bring to the Team

  • 1‑4 years of hands‑on mobile UA buying for consumer apps, games, utilities, or subscription products. Ideally, experience with In‑app ads monetized products
  • Proven experience managing Mobile App campaigns across Meta, Google, TikTok (SRNs/SANs), Programmatic DSPs, Rewarded Ad Networks, and more
  • Strong analytical skills fluent in Excel/Sheets and familiar with tools like MixPanel, Google Analytics, Looker, Tableau, Singular (BI Tools & Attribution Frameworks)
  • Experience with MMPs and performance marketing attribution
  • Experience collaborating cross‑functionally with Product, Monetization, and Creative teams
  • Strong communication and reporting skills with the ability to clearly articulate insights and recommendations
  • Bonus: Experience with ASO, web‑to‑app flows, rewarded traffic, or viral growth strategies
  • Alignment with our core values:
    • Accountable: You take ownership of your responsibilities, demonstrating trustworthiness and self‑discipline. You are consistent in your work, transparent in your actions, and communicate effectively. You follow through on commitments and strive for continuous improvement.
    • Action‑driven: Identify what is most important, agree on scope, execute in a timely manner, and drive the greatest impact. You take initiative, roll up your sleeves, and get things done.
    • Caring: You genuinely care about yourself and others, our business and craft, our mission and vision, and are passionate in heart and mind. You understand the importance of our team and strive to create a positive, supportive work environment.
    • Curious: You focus on the "why," learn and expand your knowledge, explore new ideas, and generally make things better. You’re a lifelong learner with a thirst for knowledge and a constant desire to improve.
    • Thorough: Your work is thoughtful, impactful, timely, accurate, and complete. You pay attention to detail, are meticulous, and ensure quality work and compliance.

Why Join Mode Mobile

  • Be part of a company where the culture is the magic – collaborative, humble, hungry, and invested in each other’s success
  • Make an impact across a global portfolio of consumer apps with meaningful scale

title: Montevideo Development Graduate Programme
description:
Based in Montevideo, the two-year Development Graduate Programme offers, 3 × 8 month rotations, across Deals Desk, Operations and Trade Finance in Energy or Metals and Minerals.

Throughout the programme, graduates gain practical experience and exposure to the full trade lifecycle, working at the core of our operations. By building expertise across these critical functions, graduates develop a strong foundation for success in high-impact middle office roles in Deals Desk, Operations and Trade Finance and are well-positioned to grow into future leadership positions.

Guided by some of the most experienced professionals in the industry, graduates receive ongoing support and development opportunities, providing them with the skills, mindset and confidence to help shape the next chapter of our business.

Deals Desk

Deals Desk is responsible for accurate mark-to-market valuation, daily P&L and risk and exposure reporting. Deals Desk is an independent control function that works closely with commercial, middle and back office teams to ensure timely trade capture and effective management of trading positions in our trading and risk management systems.

Responsibilities

  • Reviewing and verify trades and trade terms
  • Producing daily P&L and exposure reports
  • Liaising with traders, operations and finance to reconcile positions
  • Investigating and resolving trade discrepancies

Operations

Operations coordinates the physical movement and delivery of commodities, ensuring contracts are executed efficiently and profitably.

Responsibilities

  • Managing vessel or land logistics and documentation
  • Liaising with counter parties and terminal
  • Tracking cargo movements and inventories
  • Ensuring compliance with contractual and regulatory requirements

Trade Finance

Trade Finance designs and implements the financing solutions that enables the physical movement commodities, while managing credit and performance risks.

Responsibilities

  • Structuring and executing real-world commodity trade finance deals
  • Drafting, negotiating and managing trade documents such as letters of credit, guarantees and receivables financing
  • Monitoring global trade flows, payment schedules and risk exposure across complex transactions
  • Collaborating with traders, operations, credit teams and banking partners to resolve day-to-day financing and logistics challenges

Knowledge Skills And Abilities

  • 0-2 years of postgraduate working experience
  • Fluency in English and Spanish - both oral and written
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • High degree of intellectual curiosity, passion, motivation and grit
  • Ability to remove roadblocks and break down barriers to get the job done
  • Passion for working in a collaborative, challenging and dynamic environment
  • A global, innovative mindset

Applications will close on 31st May 2026.

description:
Description

Our team is seeking an Environmental Specialist responsible for managing environmental compliance at Amazon Transportation. The Environmental Specialist will complete environmental inspections and performance analyses, monitor metrics, undertake waste activities for the site and facilitate site implementation of Amazon's environmental standards. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. We not only celebrate the diversity of our workforce, we celebrate the diverse ways we work. If you would like to request an accommodation for the interview or onboarding process, please let our team know and we will connect you to our accommodation team. This is an onsite/in person role.

Key job responsibilities

  • Site execution of environmental procedures and ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, regional, and local regulations.
  • Manage and execute site responsibilities to comply with air emissions, surface water, wastewater, waste, and other environmental related laws, regulations and permits.
  • Manage and prepare site‑specific environmental reporting to regulators and within Amazon.
  • Manage and execute waste activities, classification, reporting and permitting requirements.
  • Execute waste and surface water site inspections.
  • Monitor and provide guidance on site performance against applicable environmental regulations, programs and Amazon global standards.
  • Analyze environmental metrics and review weekly and monthly trends to determine where improvements are needed.
  • Execute site‑specific tasks associated with the implementation of Environmental Program Assessment.
  • Support in measuring and analyzing the site's performance against requirements in environmental procedures and identify a plan for the site to remedy all deficiencies.
  • Execute relevant environmental procedures as dictated by business and regulatory needs.
  • Support in evaluating and developing process improvements for identified risks.
  • Aid in facilitating root cause analyses for all environmental incidents and recommend appropriate corrective actions for network implementation.
  • Identify and implement corrective actions to eliminate any observed or at‑risk non‑compliance scenarios.

A day in the life

The Environmental Specialist will assist in implementation and enforcement of standards and policies to support environmental and regulatory compliance and provide guidance for operations, maintenance and construction teams.

About the team

The Environmental Assurance and Protection team protects Amazon businesses and supports the needs of our customers by proactively mitigating environmental regulatory risks and protecting the environment.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Expertise serving as an environmental technical resource, environmental specialist.
  • Knowledge of federal, state and municipal regulations.
  • Experience engaging with Regulatory Agencies.
  • Availability to work in‑person all work days.
  • Advanced English and fluent Portuguese.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering or Environmental Science.
  • Broad knowledge of BR and local environmental regulations.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and the use of pivot tables and the development of charts and graphics.
  • Experience profiling and managing hazardous and non‑hazardous waste.
  • Experience in warehouse operations and logistics will be a differential.
  • Advanced English and fluent Portuguese.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: HSS and Signalling Engineer - São Paulo/Rio de Janeiro Based
description:
Company Overview

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform - including its own owned and operated global mobile core network, fully fledged in-house developed eSIM technology, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses - 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide.

We serve many of the world's leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, global fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally, enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues in 2025 exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million, we generate strong cash flows to fund our growth allowing us to continuously invest in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass-consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own aspirations to offer telecommunications services to their clients.

Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs, Hakan Koçand Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications. We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.

About the Team

As a Network Engineering member, in the Signalling functional area, you will be responsible for proposing, analysing, and defining the requirements for new and existing services and systems related to the signalling routing area and subscriber data management systems under the responsibility of the functional area. Prepare, design, test and provide new solutions or product changes of the already existing portfolio. Define and support the technology evolution roadmap for the systems under the functional area. Participate and support the other functional areas in cross functional projects.

About the Role

  • Collaboration with other Network teams in defining and managing the projects for delivery of new solutions
  • Project delivery, network design, integration, and migration strategy definition. Collaboration with other relevant departments and responsible for end-to-end delivery
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Creation of technical documentation (HLD's, LLD's, WO's, etc.) and maintain it over the lifecycle of the solutions
  • Perform implementations in live environment and understand end-to-end system testing requirements
  • Follow-up and define quality and performance indicators
  • Capacity and performance analysis, reporting and improvement solution definition
  • Service & resource configuration definition and implementation on requested systems
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and address design issues for future products or technologies
  • Maintain close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers
  • Elaborate and manage the process for change requests to current partners to meet network necessities
  • Control the network elements roadmap and be responsible for necessary software/hardware upgrades during component lifecycle
  • Generate and implement process improvements, including cross-team processes
  • Document the existing technology portfolio and propose recommendations for improvements and/or alternatives

Requirements

About You

  • Proven experience implementing live solutions on mobile telecom (GSM, UMTS, LTE, IMS), networks design, capacity management, engineering and architecture
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, GSMA, ITU standards and specifications
  • Experience designing, testing and operating signalling network functions, including STPs, DEA/DRAs and HLR/HSS
  • Experience defining, establishing and maintaining signalling interconnects, SIGTRAN and DIAMETER based, using SCTP multi-homing
  • Experience with HLR/HSS, subscriber profiles, subscriber repositories and respective reference interfaces
  • Knowledge of IMS architecture, including Application Servers and interaction with profile repositories
  • Experience in mobile services charging (online). Knowledge and experience of Ro, Gy, Gx interfaces
  • Knowledge and experience with signalling protocols and routing including M3UA, M2PA, DIAMETER, as well as upper layer protocols such as MAP, CAMEL, Sh, Cx
  • Knowledge of 5G SA networks, from a signalling (SCP and SEPP) and AUSF/UDM/UDR perspective
  • Experience with protocol analyser tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot network error/problem for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape
  • English proficiency mandatory; other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice-to-haves

  • +3 years working on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks
  • Previous experience with Nokia, Oracle, HPE products

Benefits

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses — to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave — 180 days maternity leave and 20 days paternity leave
  • Daycare allowance — provided to mothers with children under 3 years old, R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities — Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure — Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team — From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly be exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment — Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
  • Professional Development — Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field
  • International Experience — Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
  • Open Communication Culture — Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude — Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer; we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat family relocation package.

Overview

We are seeking an operational auditor with substantial auditing or operational experience in Upstream or Downstream to join Internal Auditing Organization.

The Internal Auditing is responsible for helping organizations to accomplish their objectives by bringing a systematic and disciplined approach to evaluate and improve the effectiveness of the organization’s risk management, control, and governance processes.

Your primary role will be to lead and oversee the audit team while serving as the primary liaison for clients, ensuring strong relationships and high-quality delivery throughout the engagement.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Establish the objective and scope of the audit engagement.
  • Identify key risks and controls within the business and operational processes under review.
  • Develop comprehensive risk-based audit programs.
  • Responsible for the audit team and will be overseeing assistant auditors.
  • Discuss concerns and issues with the audit client, draft field memorandums, and update client and Internal Auditing Management on progress of the audit.
  • Execute risk-based audit procedures in alignment with company policies and international standards.
  • Deliver presentations to client management at the audit opening and closing meetings.
  • Provide on-the-job training and mentoring to less experienced staff.
  • Evaluate the performance and capabilities of the assisting staff auditors.
  • Provide assurance and consulting activities on internal controls as requested.
  • As a successful candidate, you will hold a bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, engineering, or another related field; an advanced degree is a plus.
  • You will have a minimum of 7 years of experience in auditing, engineering, or plant operations within the oil and gas industry or from one of the Big Four Auditing firms (Deloitte, PwC, EY and KPMG)
  • You should hold at least one professional certification, such as the Certified Internal Auditor, Certified Public Accountant, Chartered Accountant, or a similar professional credentials.
  • You must demonstrate excellent oral and written communication skills in the English language and excellent presentation and interpersonal skills.
  • You should be flexible to travel within the Kingdom and/or outside the Kingdom to conduct audit and consulting engagements.

Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer. With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

title: MÉDICO SAÚDE DA FAMÍLIA - AP 4.0
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Estratégia Saúde da Família consiste em uma reorientação do modelo assistencial, realizada mediante a implantação de equipes multiprofissionais em Clínicas de Saúde da Família. Estas equipes ficam responsáveis pelo acompanhamento de um número definido de famílias de áreas geográficas delimitadas, atuando com ações de prevenção e promoção à saúde dessa comunidade.

As equipes da ESF são compostas por Médico Generalista ou Médico de Família e Comunidade, Enfermeiro, Auxiliar ou Técnico de Enfermagem e Agentes Comunitários de Saúde (ACS).

Também há equipe de Saúde Bucal, composta por cirurgião-dentista generalista ou especialista em saúde da família, auxiliar e/ou técnico em Saúde Bucal.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Realizar atendimento na Estratégia Saúde da Família, conforme as diretrizes da Secretaria Municipal da Saúde e protocolos existentes. Realizar assistência à população sob o âmbito da promoção e proteção da saúde, prevenção de agravos, diagnóstico, tratamento, reabilitação e manutenção da saúde individual, coletiva e incluindo ações no domicilio. Realizar interface com a Rede Assistencial à Saúde, atuando de forma integral na coordenação do cuidado, através de ações que facilitem o acesso, integralidade, longitudinalidade, resolutividade e a participação da comunidade nos Serviços de Saúde.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Desejável experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Médico.

Informações adicionais

Local de trabalho: AP 4.0 (Jacarepaguá, Barra da Tijuca, Recreio e adjacências)

title: Cientista de Dados Sênior | Growth
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Globo é feita de gente que quer fazer diferente, fazer junto, fazer o futuro. Gente espalhada por todo o país (e mundo!) trabalhando com conteúdo, notícias, negócios, tecnologia e brasilidade de sobra. Canais na TV aberta e por assinatura, produtos digitais como Globoplay, Cartola, G1, Ge, Gshow e outros serviços estão reunidos no mesmo lugar, na mesma Globo.

Novos modelos de negócios digitais estão sendo pensados e desenvolvidos, buscando nos aproximar cada vez mais do usuário e dos seus desejos. As oportunidades de novos negócios também trazem a chance e o desafio de construirmos novos times data-driven e que coloquem o consumidor no centro das nossas decisões.

Sobre a área

O time de Marketing Insights e Martech é uma frente de tecnologia e analítica dentro do marketing dos produtos digitais da Globo (Globoplay, Premiere, Telecine, Cartola, GE, G1 etc). Estudam o comportamento dos usuários (assinantes ou não), hábitos e interações com a plataforma e canais de comunicação. Respondem também pelas predições e acompanhamentos das vendas, custo por aquisição, investimento em mídias online e offline, além de dados de cancelamento dos assinantes. Além disso, são responsáveis por toda operação de envio das comunicações e gestão das ferramentas de CRM e mídia.

A área de Growth é responsável por acelerar o crescimento sustentável dos produtos digitais da Globo. Atuando no planejamento, execução e otimização das campanhas de mídia online e CRM com foco em performance, eficiência de investimento e aprendizado contínuo.

Diversidade : Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será seu dia a dia

O trabalho consiste em limpar, transformar e modelar dados brutos em informações consumíveis para a tomada de decisões estratégicas. Durante o processo de obtenção dos dados brutos até a disponibilização dos dados limpos e transformados, além de construir tabelas e análises posteriores para relatórios, dashboards e apresentações pontuais.

Requisitos e qualificações

Do que você precisa

  • Construir pipelines de dados aplicando lógica de negócios, escolhendo níveis de agregação, agrupando e transformando campos, verificando a qualidade e limpando os dados;
  • Organizar e modelar as camadas de dados, fornecendo uma estrutura concisa que permita geração de análises e levantamento de KPIs;
  • Desenvolvimento de soluções self-service de dados;
  • Realizar análises exploratórias;
  • Construir, produtizar, avaliar e dar manutenção a modelos de Machine Learning visando o aumento de engajamento, retenção e entendimento do comportamento dos usuários;
  • Trabalhar com times de tecnologia, engenharia e analytics;
  • Realização de testes A/B para análises e incrementabilidade;
  • Dialogar com as partes interessadas para entender suas necessidades primárias, sendo capaz de operar de forma eficaz e autônoma em várias equipes em situações de ambiguidade, apenas com direcionamento de alto nível;
  • Evangelizar a utilização de dados, ensinando e compartilhando as melhores práticas.

Conhecimentos que te destacam

  • Experiência com analytics e ferramentas para marketing digital (AppsFlyer, Comscore etc.);
  • Experiência com PySpark;
  • Experiências com ferramenta de modelagem de dados como DBT ou Dataform;
  • Experiência em marketing mix modeling (MMM).

Informações adicionais

Por que vir para Globo

Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos. Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação. A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles. Aqui, cada um faz a transformação acontecer.

Nossos processos seletivos estão acontecendo de forma 100% remota e nós encorajamos inscrições de qualquer lugar do Brasil e do mundo. #vempraglobo

Os seus dados pessoais serão utilizados para fins de seleção de candidatos para preenchimento das vagas abertas na Globo. Os dados pessoais coletados durante o processo seletivo dos candidatos que não forem admitidos neste momento poderão ser mantidos nos bancos de dados para consideração em futuros processos seletivos. Todos os dados coletados serão tratados segundo rígidos padrões de segurança da informação e em total respeito às leis de privacidade aplicáveis, incluindo a Lei 13.709/18, e nos termos de nossa política de privacidade, disponível no link: Ao prosseguir você está ciente e de acordo para realização de sua candidatura nestes termos.

title: Analista de DP
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Basic Function

Reporting to the Assistant Vice President of Multimedia & Digital Communications, in the Office of University Communications, the Videographer/Multimedia Specialist is responsible for planning, directing, and conducting video and photo shoots both in studio and on location. The role involves capturing content related to Howard University leadership, campus events, activities, and meetings. The position also entails producing storytelling content that aligns with the University’s brand identity and supports its reputation. Strong storytelling abilities, technical proficiency, and photography skills are required to create various types of digital and long‑form video content to address institutional objectives.

Supervisory Accountability

Supervises student interns as needed. No other accountabilities are projected in this role.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include faculty, staff, administrators, students and University leadership. External contacts include vendors, partners, and alumni.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Develops visual/audiovisual/still photography strategies to support the brand identity of Howard University.
  • Collaborates with Office of University Communications (OUC) team members to conceptualize and plan video solutions to meet institutional goals and objectives.
  • Attends and contributes to regular meetings within the Office of University Communications.
  • Works collaboratively with digital content producers across the University, including faculty, staff, and students.
  • Plans, directs, and executes video and photo shoots in studio and on location.
  • Demonstrates the ability to handle all phases of assigned projects from concept through final delivery.
  • Demonstrates strong photography skills for an adaptive environment when photography needs are required.
  • Edits and color grades projects using non‑linear software such as Adobe Lightroom, Premiere, etc.
  • Engages approved freelance support as needed.
  • Independently provides stylized, creative content within the University’s brand guidelines.
  • Grasp of best practices for accessibility, captioning, and SRT files.
  • Communicates effectively with staff and internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective, relevant and timely completion of assignments.
  • Research and provides advice on the latest industry‑related practices and technologies.
  • Transports equipment and/or travel to locations via personal vehicle or University transportation to assignments.
  • Manages and catalogues content in the internal digital asset management system.
  • Conducts routine equipment maintenance.
  • Successfully manages multiple projects.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Experience with directing on‑camera talent, participants, or personalities is a strong plus.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to work in various positions on a production crew.
  • Strength in creativity, organization, attention to detail, and ability to function as part of a team independently with specific or ambiguous direction.
  • Experience using Canon ecosystem a plus.
  • Strong production and post‑production skills.
  • Knowledge of current and emerging trends in social media, generative AI, AI workflows, streaming platforms, and digital video marketing is a big plus.
  • Experience capturing both portrait‑style content and live event coverage is a strong plus.
  • Experience setting up and managing audio for video productions.
  • Some familiarity with generative AI production workflows, including but not limited to Midjourney, KIng, Suno, Google Labs (Veo/Flow, etc), and other emerging tools. Ability to integrate these technologies into storytelling, ideation, and post‑production pipelines is a major plus.
  • Ability to consistently meet deadlines, successfully multi‑task, and work within established brand/product guidelines.
  • Computer proficient and proficient in non‑linear editing, Adobe Premiere, Adobe After Effects, and related software.
  • Proficient in visual production and design software, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and Adobe Lightroom.
  • General administrative software programs including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, FTP clients, general internet search, and research skills.
  • Strong drive and initiative. Self‑motivated.
  • Media file management and organization and understanding of multiple digital media formats, codecs, and containers.
  • Strong communication skills.
  • Animation skills are a plus but not required.
  • Understands the power of feedback and input on projects.
  • Positive, professional attitude and strong team player.

Minimum Requirements

A bachelor’s degree in photography, film, video production, or a related field. 2 or more years of general production experience, including shooting, interviewing, recording, editing and finished professional quality video media. Ability to work outside of normal business hours, including travel outside of the area.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

  • Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding).

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. REQUISITOS

O que você precisa ter:

  • Diploma de Licenciatura em Dança;

Nossos professores devem ser capazes de/devem ter:

  • Paixão pela profissão;
  • Adaptar seu estilo de ensino incorporando feedbacks;
  • Estar sempre em busca de melhorias;
  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Compreensão profunda da matéria lecionada;
  • Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas;
  • Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala;
  • Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado;

  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Espírito colaborativo - desejo de trabalhar como parte de um time;
  • Pós-graduação em andamento ou concluída.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Job Description

Buscamos um profissional organizado, analítico e sensível para cuidar da experiência do cliente (CX), assegurando que cada interação na jornada e toda a comunicação sejam consistentes, claras e realmente valiosas. Aqui na Beep Saúde, nos orgulhamos de ter um NPS acima de 90, que reflete nossa reputação e cuidado com a experiência dos nossos clientes.

Responsibilities and assignments

  • Mapeamento e Otimização de Jornadas: Mapear, analisar, documentar e otimizar continuamente as jornadas do cliente, identificando pontos de dor (pain points), oportunidades de melhoria e gargalos de atrito para elevar a satisfação e retenção, contribuindo diretamente para o nosso alto NPS.
  • Gestão de Mensageria e Conteúdo (CX Writing): Cuidar de toda a mensageria (textos, comunicações, notificações e micro-textos), garantindo que estejam alinhados, acessíveis e alinhados à jornada do cliente.
  • Integração com a Tecnologia: Atuar lado a lado com o time de Produto e Tecnologia para desenvolver e implantar soluções que impactem positivamente a jornada e experiência dos nossos clientes.
  • Governança e Documentação: Organizar, documentar e ser o ponto focal para garantir o alinhamento e a disseminação de conhecimento sobre as jornadas e guidelines de comunicação entre as áreas envolvidas (ex: Marketing, Produto, Atendimento).
  • Análise de Dados de CX: Utilizar dados e feedbacks de clientes para embasar decisões e medir o impacto das melhorias implementadas nas jornadas e na comunicação, com foco na manutenção e aumento do NPS.
  • Garantir que as mensagens estejam em conformidade com as diretrizes da Meta, com pleno entendimento das políticas da plataforma e aplicação correta dos tipos aprovados (utilidade, autenticação, marketing e serviço) nos fluxos de comunicação.

Requirements And Qualifications

  • Formação/Experiência: Sólida formação ou experiência comprovada em Design (UX/UI), Comunicação, Marketing, Produto ou áreas correlatas.
  • Perfil Comportamental: Pessoa extremamente detalhista, organizada e com alta sensibilidade para trabalhar com a experiência e a comunicação humana (empatia e escuta ativa).
  • Visão Customer Centric: Capacidade de colocar o cliente no centro de todas as decisões e enxergar de forma holística todos os pontos de contato (touchpoints) da jornada.
  • Habilidade de Colaboração: Facilidade e experiência em trabalhar com diferentes equipes multifuncionais, especialmente times de Tecnologia, Produto, Operações.
  • Comunicação Excepcional: Excelente habilidade de comunicação verbal e escrita para defender o ponto de vista do cliente e traduzir complexidades em mensagens simples e eficazes.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, etc.) e ferramentas de mapeamento de jornada (Miro, Figma, etc.).
  • Conhecimento e aplicação de princípios de CX Writing e Microcopy.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de análise de CX, especialmente gestão de NPS e CSAT.

description:
The Service Engineer will be responsible for meeting the daily maintenance and repair needs of customer equipment. They must establish and maintain appropriate business relationships with customers and colleagues, as well as perform necessary administrative activities and other assigned functions.

In this role, your responsibilities will be:

Onboard Service Execution:

  • Provide support, supervise, and test/troubleshoot field issues onboard vessels and various offshore units. This includes sailing/staying onboard vessels/units while handling services and warranty-related matters.
  • Execute the requested service in the best possible way to meet customer deadlines and expectations.

Commissioning and On-site Sea Trial Execution:

  • Test, calibrate, and verify the system configuration within Emerson ICMS software and other ICMS supplies and Emerson marine products.
  • Deliver and obtain approvals from the Shipyard, Owner, and Class during sea trials.

Reports / Administrative Activities:

  • Clearly written work reports must be completed upon returning from trips, in English, detailing all follow-up points.
  • Onboard service reports must be signed by customers.
  • Stay up to date on administrative responsibilities such as maintaining internal service reports and internal records in a timely manner.

Participation in FAT Tests:

  • Participate in customer equipment workshop tests, together with project engineering, the end customer, and Class.

Training:

  • Participate in all trainings and meetings as required by Emerson.
  • Participate in, observe, and comply with the company’s health and safety guidelines and contribute to a safe work environment.
  • Attend local trainings in the workshop/laboratory/classroom in Denmark and other locations as needed to obtain product updates.
  • Provide basic on-site/onboard training for customers/crews.

Who You Are:

You use customer insights to guide and direct the development of new offerings. You go beyond the obvious and do not stop at the first answers. You anticipate conflicts before they happen, based on your understanding of interpersonal and group dynamics. You act quickly and decisively in unpredictable and fast-changing situations. You take consistent action to develop new skills.

For this role, you will need:

  • Electrical/Mechanical education with strong knowledge of software and hardware. Additional certifications or training in maintenance, repair, or technical fields related to marine equipment are a plus.
  • 3 years of experience in a similar role, with hands‑on troubleshooting, repair, and maintenance of complex technical equipment or systems. Ability to work in a global environment.
  • Experience dealing with customers in high‑pressure environments.
  • Availability to work overtime, as needed.
  • Computer literacy and experience with MS Office and Excel.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese, written and spoken.

Our Culture and Commitment to You:

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where all employees are valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We promote an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives, because we know great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to continuous career development and fostering an inclusive culture ensures that you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe that diverse teams, working together, are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

We recognize the importance of employee well‑being. We offer medical, dental, pharmacy, and Wellhub (Gympass) benefits; life insurance; credit union; private pension plan; recognition programs, and much more. Our people‑focused culture includes resource groups and an employee assistance program, as well as extended parental leave (both maternal and paternal) as part of our Empresa Cidadã certification.
